# Bosco Labs data APIs

> Bosco Labs publishes data tools for AI agents and analysts as Apify Actors that return clean, typed JSON from official sources: SEC filings, insider trades, 13F holdings and XBRL financials, US House STOCK Act trades, European ESEF annual reports, UK/Danish/Norwegian company accounts and registries, sanctions lists, EU, UK and Dutch law and case law, EU tenders, US federal and Pentagon contract awards, ECB rates and euro inflation, clinical trials, Dutch addresses, plus PDF-to-JSON and Apify dataset tools. Each Actor runs on the Apify platform via API or MCP and is priced per result (pay per event). Data rows carry a source link. Tools marked 'coming soon' are built but not yet public on the Store.

Apify Store profile: https://apify.com/bosco_labs
Contact: support@boscolabs.dev

## Finance & SEC

- [SEC Insider Trading API (Form 4): live + history since 2006](https://boscolabs.dev/sec-insider-trades.html): Every insider purchase and sale reported on SEC Form 4 (directors, officers, 10% owners), from official EDGAR filings, 2006 to today, with cluster-buy and cluster-sell signals; filter by ticker, CIK, transaction code, role, value and date. Price: $0.0018 per transaction row and $0.02 per cluster signal. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/sec-insider-trades))
- [SEC EDGAR Filings API: 8-K, 10-K, 10-Q feed since 1994](https://boscolabs.dev/sec-filings-feed.html): SEC EDGAR filings (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q, S-1, 13D, 13G, Form 4 and every other form) for any company or the whole market, live or back to 1994, from the SEC's own feeds; 8-K item codes and earnings releases (Item 2.02); links to each filing, not its text. Price: $0.001 per filing. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/sec-filings-feed))
- [Congress Stock Trades API: US House STOCK Act since 2014](https://boscolabs.dev/us-house-trades.html): Congress stock trades: stock, option, fund and bond trades that US House members disclose in STOCK Act Periodic Transaction Reports, from the Clerk of the House's official filings since January 2014 (no Senate); ticker, amount range, owner, days to disclose. Price: $0.0018 per trade. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/us-house-trades))
- [SEC Ownership API: 13F Holdings, 13D/13G Stakes, Form 144](https://boscolabs.dev/sec-ownership.html): Who owns a stock and who is selling, from official SEC filings: a fund's 13F holdings with quarter-over-quarter changes, the funds holding a ticker, 5%+ stakes (13D activist, 13G passive) and Form 144 planned insider sales. One ticker or fund in, small JSON out, a source link per row. Price: $0.0018 per row. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [SEC Company Financials API: income, balance sheet, cash flow](https://boscolabs.dev/sec-company-financials.html): US company financials from SEC XBRL: revenue, profit, EPS, balance sheet, cash flow, free cash flow and margins per fiscal year or quarter, 2009 to today. By ticker or CIK, 10-K/10-Q and 20-F filers. Each value cites its XBRL tag and SEC filing. Q4 derived where not reported. Price: $0.005 per company-period row. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [SEC Company Screener API: filter all US filers by financials](https://boscolabs.dev/sec-company-screen.html): US companies matching your filters for one calendar year or quarter: revenue, net income, margins, cash flow, assets and 30 more metrics from SEC XBRL frames, sorted and capped. Each value cites its XBRL tag and SEC filing. Same metrics as SEC Company Financials. Price: $0.002 per company returned. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [EU Annual Reports API (ESEF): XBRL financial statements](https://boscolabs.dev/esef-annual-reports.html): Normalized key financials (revenue, EBIT, EBITDA, net income, EPS, assets, equity, cash flows, margins, growth) of European listed companies from official ESEF annual reports via filings.xbrl.org; 28 countries; every value linked to its XBRL fact. Price: $0.01 per run plus $0.05 per annual report; raw XBRL fact rows, if switched on, $0.0005 each. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/esef-annual-reports))

## Companies

- [Company Check API: identity, financials & SEC filings in 1 call](https://boscolabs.dev/company-check.html): One company report per call: legal name, LEI, registration number, status, address and industry, years of revenue, profit, equity, assets and cash, SEC filings and FDIC bank data. Look up by name, LEI, UK, DK, NO, FR, FI or EE number, ticker, CIK or FDIC cert. Sourced values. Price: $0.03 per report. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [Company Financials API: UK, Denmark & Norway accounts + LEI](https://boscolabs.dev/company-accounts.html): Financials (revenue, profit, equity, assets, cash, employees) of private and public companies from official accounts: UK Companies House, Denmark Erhvervsstyrelsen, Norway Brønnøysund; adds the LEI from GLEIF and a source per value. Price: $0.04 per company-year. ([Apify Store](https://apify.com/bosco_labs/company-accounts))
- [UK New Companies API: daily Companies House incorporations](https://boscolabs.dev/uk-new-companies.html): New UK companies incorporated on any day (default: yesterday) from the official Companies House API: number, name, type, status, SIC codes with descriptions, registered office address and a register link. Filter by SIC prefix, location and type. No director data. Price: $0.002 per company. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [Company Hiring Signals API: open roles, departments, locations](https://boscolabs.dev/company-hiring-signals.html): Is a company hiring? Open roles by department, location and remote share, newest and oldest posting dates and top titles, plus job rows with a link each. Read from the company's public Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby job board. Look up by name, domain or board URL. Price: $0.005 per company found plus $0.001 per job row. (coming soon to the Apify Store)

## Compliance & law

- [Sanctions Screening API: OFAC, UK, EU & US export lists](https://boscolabs.dev/sanctions-screening.html): Is this company, vessel or person sanctioned? Returns per name: match yes/no, the listed entry, aliases, programs, listing date, identifiers and a source link, from the official OFAC SDN and non-SDN, US Consolidated Screening List, UK Sanctions List and EU lists, with each list's date. Price: $0.01 per name screened. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [EU Law Lookup API (EUR-Lex): article text, in force, amendments](https://boscolabs.dev/eu-law-lookup.html): The text of an EU law article as in force today (or on a date), whether the act is in force, what amended it, plus new Official Journal acts. Ask by name (GDPR, AI Act), citation, CELEX or ELI; 24 languages. Official EUR-Lex/Cellar data with a source link per row. Price: $0.01 per act or article returned. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [UK & Dutch Law Lookup API: article text by date, in force](https://boscolabs.dev/national-law-lookup.html): The text of a UK section or Dutch article as in force today (or on a date), whether it is in force and what changed it. Ask by citation: "Companies Act 2006 s 172", "BW 7:658", "artikel 13 Wet Vpb 1969". Official legislation.gov.uk and Dutch BWB data with a source link per row. Price: $0.01 per article or act returned. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [Dutch Case Law API (Rechtspraak): ECLI lookup, uitspraken](https://boscolabs.dev/dutch-case-law.html): Dutch court decisions (uitspraken) by ECLI or search: court, dates, case numbers, legal area, summary (inhoudsindicatie), appeal/cassation relations, law references and optional text. Hoge Raad, Raad van State, gerechtshoven, rechtbanken. Official Rechtspraak Open Data, source link per row. Price: $0.005 per decision returned. (coming soon to the Apify Store)

## Government & procurement

- [EU Public Tenders & Contract Awards API (TED procurement)](https://boscolabs.dev/eu-tenders.html): EU public procurement notices from TED (Tenders Electronic Daily), the EU's official tenders journal: open calls with deadlines, contract awards with winners and values, prior information; EU, EEA and more, since 2016; filter by keyword, country, CPV code, notice type, date, EUR value. Price: $0.002 per notice. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [Pentagon / DoD Contract Awards API: winners, amounts, tickers](https://boscolabs.dev/dod-contract-awards.html): US Department of Defense contract awards of $7.5M or more the same evening they are announced, plus USAspending.gov history since FY2008 (any federal agency); winner, amount, service, NAICS/PSC, matched to a US stock ticker with SEC shares outstanding. Price: $0.005 per award row. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [US Federal Awards API: contracts & grants, all agencies](https://boscolabs.dev/us-federal-awards.html): US federal contract, grant and loan awards from every agency (USAspending.gov): winner, UEI, parent company, stock ticker, agency, amounts, dates, NAICS/PSC/assistance listing, place of performance and a source link. Filter by company, ticker, agency, keyword, state, date. Price: $0.004 per award row. (coming soon to the Apify Store)

## Macro, health & places

- [ECB Rates & Euro Inflation API: policy rates, FX, €STR, HICP](https://boscolabs.dev/eu-rates-inflation.html): Latest value, previous value, change and recent history of ECB policy rates, euro reference FX rates, €STR, euro-area and national bond yields, and Eurostat HICP inflation. Ask by plain name (ecb_deposit_rate, eur_fx:USD, hicp:NL), no SDMX keys. Official data, a source link per series. Price: $0.002 per series returned. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [ClinicalTrials.gov API: trial search & NCT dossier](https://boscolabs.dev/clinical-trials.html): Clinical trials as compact JSON rows: status, phase, sponsor, conditions, interventions, enrollment, start and primary completion dates, countries, outcomes and results. Look up NCT numbers or search by condition, drug, sponsor, phase, status, country and dates. Sourced, no contact data. Price: $0.004 per trial. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [Dutch Address Lookup API: BAG postcode, geocode & building data](https://boscolabs.dev/dutch-address-lookup.html): Validates and geocodes Dutch addresses against the official BAG register (via PDOK): postcode, BAG ids, WGS84 + RD coordinates, construction year, use, floor area and building status. Free text, postcode + house number (or range) or BAG ids; up to 100 per run. Unmatched inputs are free. Price: $0.002 per resolved address. (coming soon to the Apify Store)

## Data tools

- [PDF to JSON API: text, tables and metadata from a PDF URL](https://boscolabs.dev/pdf-to-data.html): PDF text, tables and metadata as clean JSON from 1-20 public PDF URLs or a base64 file: per-page markdown text in reading order, tables as rows with a header guess, title, author and dates. Processed in memory, never stored. Pay per page with text; scanned pages are flagged and free. Price: $0.0005 per page with text. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [Deduplicate & Merge Apify Datasets: remove duplicate items](https://boscolabs.dev/dataset-dedup.html): Deduplicate and merge one or more Apify datasets (or a pasted JSON array): removes duplicate items by any fields (dot paths allowed) or by the whole item, keeping the first or last occurrence; streams millions of items with constant memory. Price: $0.00015 per unique item written (duplicates are free). (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [Change Monitor: new, changed & removed items + Slack alerts](https://boscolabs.dev/dataset-change-monitor.html): Run any scraper on a schedule and get only what changed: new, changed and removed items compared with the previous run, matched by your key fields (e.g. url). Optional Slack, Discord, Telegram, email or webhook alert per run. Add it as an integration to your scraper. Price: $0.001 per change reported. (coming soon to the Apify Store)
- [Google Sheets Export: send any Apify dataset to a spreadsheet](https://boscolabs.dev/sheets-export.html): Export any Apify dataset to Google Sheets: replace a tab or append rows, with nested fields as columns and your header kept; writes with your own Google service account key and retries Google rate limits. Price: $0.00015 per row exported. (coming soon to the Apify Store)

## How to call

- Apify API (synchronous): POST `https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/bosco_labs~<actor>/run-sync-get-dataset-items` with header `Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>` and the Actor input as the JSON body; the response is the dataset items.
- Apify hosted MCP server: add `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/<actor>` to your MCP client (Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ...). It loads the Actor as a tool plus `get-actor-run` and `get-dataset-items`, and signs you in with OAuth or `Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>`. On the default server (`https://mcp.apify.com`) agents can also find the Actors with `search-actors` and run them with `call-actor`.
- Pricing: pay per event, billed to your own Apify account: you pay for rows delivered at the prices listed per Actor, and runs stop at your max charge limit.
- Bosco Labs HTTP API: `POST https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/<tool>` with `Authorization: Bearer <key>` for 8 fast lookups (same input and rows as the Actors), prepaid credits, $0.50 free trial; remote MCP at `https://api.boscolabs.dev/mcp`. Keys, prices and limits: https://boscolabs.dev/api.html
- Contact: support@boscolabs.dev (questions, data issues, custom data requests).
- Bosco Labs MCP server: `bosco-labs-data-mcp` on PyPI (https://pypi.org/project/bosco-labs-data-mcp/) and the official MCP Registry (`io.github.PB7-debug/bosco-labs-data`): one MCP server for all data Actors. Run it with `uvx bosco-labs-data-mcp` and set `APIFY_TOKEN`; source in https://github.com/PB7-debug/bosco-labs-data/tree/main/mcp.

## API (beta, test mode)

- Base URL: https://api.boscolabs.dev; `POST /v1/<tool>` with header `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (or `X-API-Key`) and the Actor's input object as JSON body; the response holds the Actor's rows plus `charged_usd` and `balance_usd`.
- OpenAPI: https://api.boscolabs.dev/openapi.json; interactive docs: https://api.boscolabs.dev/docs; catalogue with prices and input schemas: https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/tools (free)
- Remote MCP (streamable HTTP, same key header): https://api.boscolabs.dev/mcp
- [Get a key, prices and limits](https://boscolabs.dev/api.html): prepaid credits, packs $10, $50, $200, one-time $0.50 free trial per verified e-mail; prices exclude VAT
- [Privacy](https://boscolabs.dev/privacy.html): request bodies (names screened, queries) are never logged or stored
- `company-check`: $0.03 per company report (max 1 report).
- `sec-company-financials`: $0.005 per company-period row (max 10 tickers/CIKs x 20 years).
- `sec-company-screen`: $0.002 per company returned (max 200 companies (maxResults)).
- `sec-filings-feed`: $0.001 per filing (max 200 filings (maxResults)).
- `sanctions-screening`: $0.01 per name screened (max 50 names). This product uses the International Trade Administration's Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the International Trade Administration. OFAC and CSL data are US government works. UK Sanctions List: contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. EU list: European Commission, names as published. No endorsement by any publisher is implied.
- `eu-law-lookup`: $0.005 per act or article returned (max 50 results (maxResults)). Consolidated texts from EUR-Lex (© European Union) are a documentation tool with no legal effect; only the acts published in the Official Journal of the European Union are authentic.
- `national-law-lookup`: $0.005 per article or act returned (max 10 articles). UK: contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (© Crown and database right, legislation.gov.uk).
- `eu-rates-inflation`: $0.002 per series returned (catalogue free) (max 20 series). Source: ECB statistics (data.ecb.europa.eu). The data are free of charge from the ECB; we charge for processing and delivery, not for the data. Eurostat HICP: © European Union, free of charge from Eurostat. The change field is computed by Bosco Labs.

## SEC Insider Trading API (Form 4): live + history since 2006

Docs: https://boscolabs.dev/sec-insider-trades.html
Apify Store: https://apify.com/bosco_labs/sec-insider-trades
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/sec-insider-trades
Price: $0.0018 per transaction row and $0.02 per cluster signal

Insider trading data from SEC Form 4: every insider purchase and sale by directors, officers and 10% owners, from official EDGAR filings, 2006 to today. Filter by ticker, CIK, transaction code, role, value and date; adds cluster-buy and cluster-sell signals. Use for insider screens and alerts.

Coverage: Today's filings from the EDGAR live feed, minutes after the SEC accepts them; recent quarters from the EDGAR indexes and Form 4 XML; history from 2006 from the SEC's quarterly Insider Transactions Data Sets. Non-derivative table only: options and other derivatives are not included.

Example questions:

- Did any Tesla insiders buy shares in the last 90 days?
- Show insider cluster buys across the US market this month.
- List Nvidia insider sales over $1 million filed in 2024, with links to the Form 4s.

### Input fields

- `lookbackDays` (integer): Used only when `dateFrom` is empty: read filings from this many days back until today, e.g. 30. Empty = 90 days when `tickers` or `ciks` are set, 7 days for the whole market. Handy for schedules.
- `dateFrom` (string): Earliest filing date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2024-01-01". Data starts 2006-01-01. Empty = `lookbackDays` days before today (90 for tickers/CIKs, 7 for the whole market).
- `dateTo` (string): Latest filing date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2024-12-31". Empty = today, including today's filings from the live EDGAR feed.
- `clusterBuysOnly` (boolean): true = only open-market purchases that are part of a cluster: at least 2 different directors or officers of the same company buying, filed within `clusterWindowDays`, together worth at least $100,000. Default false. Also reads the window before the date range.
- `clusterSellsOnly` (boolean): true = only open-market sales that are part of a cluster (same rule as cluster buys, for sales). Pre-planned 10b5-1 plan sales are left out (filings flag them since April 2023). Default false. Can be combined with `clusterBuysOnly`.
- `includeClusterSignals` (boolean): true (default) = also output one row per cluster signal (record_type = "cluster"): the day a company's insider buying or selling first met the cluster rule, with the insiders and total value. Charged as a separate, higher-priced event. false = transaction rows only.
- `clusterWindowDays` (integer): How many days of filings count as one cluster of insider buying or selling, e.g. 14. Default 30.
- `transactionCodes` (array): Form 4 transaction codes to return, e.g. ["P"] for open-market purchases only. Default ["P", "S"] (open-market purchases and sales). Pass [] for all codes, including awards (A), tax withholding (F) and option exercises (M).
- `insiderRoles` (array): Only insiders with one of these roles: director, officer, ten_percent_owner, other, e.g. ["director", "officer"]. Empty = all roles.
- `minValueUsd` (integer): Minimum transaction value in USD (shares x price), e.g. 100000. Default 0 = no minimum. Transactions without a price count as 0.
- `maxResults` (integer): Maximum transaction rows, newest first, e.g. 500. Default 100, up to 200,000 per run (split bigger exports by date range). The run stops reading once it has this many, and returns at most this many cluster signals.
- `onlyNewSinceLastRun` (boolean): true = skip (and don't charge for) transactions and signals an earlier run with the same filters already delivered. For scheduled runs. Default false. Remembered in a named key-value store in your account.
- `tickers` (array): Optional: issuer stock tickers, e.g. ["AAPL", "TSLA"]. Leave empty to scan the whole market (the usual use: insider buying anywhere). Mapped to the company's CIK with the SEC's ticker list; history is also matched on the ticker as written in the filing.
- `ciks` (array): Issuer SEC Central Index Keys as digits, leading zeros optional, e.g. ["320193"] for Apple. Use for delisted or renamed companies the SEC's ticker list no longer has. Empty = no CIK filter.

### Output fields

- `schema_version` (string): Output schema version.
- `record_type` (string): transaction = one Form 4 transaction; cluster = one cluster-buy or cluster-sell signal.
- `cluster_side` (string | null): Cluster rows only: buy = insiders buying together, sell = insiders selling together (10b5-1 plan sales excluded).
- `accession_number` (string): SEC accession number of the Form 4 filing.
- `form` (string): 4, or 4/A for an amendment.
- `issuer_name` (string): Company whose shares were traded, as filed.
- `issuer_cik` (string): SEC CIK of the issuer (10 digits).
- `ticker` (string | null): Issuer trading symbol as written in the filing.
- `insider_name` (string): Reporting person (the first one in a joint filing).
- `insider_cik` (string | null): SEC CIK of the reporting person.
- `insider_roles` (array): director, officer, ten_percent_owner, other (combined over all joint filers).
- `officer_title` (string | null): Officer title, e.g. Chief Executive Officer.
- `owner_count` (integer): Number of reporting persons on the filing (joint filings > 1).
- `transaction_date` (string | null): Date of the transaction (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `filing_date` (string): Date the SEC received the filing (YYYY-MM-DD). For cluster rows: the day the cluster rule was first met.
- `accepted_at` (string | null): EDGAR acceptance time with New York offset (live EDGAR rows only).
- `transaction_code` (string): Form 4 code: P purchase, S sale, A award, M option exercise, F tax withholding, G gift, ...
- `transaction_type` (string | null): Plain-English meaning of the transaction code.
- `acquired_disposed` (string | null): A = acquired, D = disposed.
- `shares` (number | null): Number of shares.
- `price` (number | null): Price per share in USD (null when the filing gives none).
- `value_usd` (number | null): shares x price.
- `shares_owned_after` (number | null): Shares owned after the transaction.
- `ownership` (string | null): direct or indirect (e.g. through a trust or fund).
- `plan_10b5_1` (boolean): Made under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan (checkbox since 2023, or a footnote saying so).
- `security_title` (string | null): Security, e.g. Common Stock.
- `cluster_insiders` (integer | null): Transactions: distinct directors/officers buying this issuer in the cluster window up to this filing date (null for non-buys or when the window reaches before the data read). Clusters: insiders in the cluster.
- `cluster_value_usd` (number | null): Total open-market purchase value of those insiders in the window.
- `in_cluster` (boolean | null): Purchases only: part of a cluster signal.
- `cluster_date` (string | null): Purchases in a cluster: the date of that cluster signal.
- `first_filing_date` (string | null): Cluster rows: filing date of the first buy in the cluster.
- `cluster_window_days` (integer | null): Cluster rows: the window used.
- `insider_names` (array | null): Cluster rows: the buying insiders.
- `accession_numbers` (array | null): Cluster rows: the Form 4 filings in the cluster.
- `filing_url` (string): EDGAR filing index page.
- `source` (string): edgar-xml (parsed Form 4 XML), dera (SEC Insider Transactions Data Sets) or derived (cluster).
- `source_url` (string | null): The exact SEC file the row was read from.
- `retrieved_at` (string): UTC time the row was produced.

### Example input

```json
{ "tickers": ["NVDA", "AAPL"], "transactionCodes": ["P", "S"], "minValueUsd": 100000,
  "dateFrom": "2024-01-01", "maxResults": 1000 }
```

## SEC EDGAR Filings API: 8-K, 10-K, 10-Q feed since 1994

Docs: https://boscolabs.dev/sec-filings-feed.html
Apify Store: https://apify.com/bosco_labs/sec-filings-feed
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/sec-filings-feed
Price: $0.001 per filing
API: POST https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/sec-filings-feed, $0.001 per filing (max 200 filings (maxResults))

SEC EDGAR filings (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q, S-1, 13D, 13G, Form 4 and every other form) for any company or the whole market, live or back to 1994, from the SEC's own feeds. Filter by ticker, CIK, form, 8-K item and date; flags earnings releases (Item 2.02). Returns links to each filing, not its text.

Coverage: All EDGAR forms. Companies: the SEC submissions API, complete history back to 1994. Whole market: the live feed, then the EDGAR daily and quarterly indexes back to 1993. 8-K item codes exist since August 2004. Rows hold links to the filing and its main document, not the document text.

Example questions:

- When did Nvidia release its last four quarterly results, and was it before or after the market closed?
- Which companies filed a 13D in the last 7 days, and who filed it?
- Give me links to Apple's 10-K annual reports since 2015.

### Input fields

- `formTypes` (array): EDGAR form types, exact match, e.g. ["8-K", "10-K", "10-Q"]; also S-1, 13D, 13G, 4, DEF 14A, 20-F, 6-K and any other form. Add "10-K/A" etc. for amendments. 13D and 13G also match the SC 13D and SCHEDULE 13D names. Empty = every form.
- `tickers` (array): Company tickers, e.g. ["AAPL", "MSFT"]. Mapped to the CIK with the SEC's own company_tickers.json. Empty (and `ciks` empty) = the whole market.
- `ciks` (array): SEC Central Index Keys as digits, leading zeros optional, e.g. ["320193"] for Apple. Use for delisted companies, funds and filers without a ticker. Empty = no CIK filter.
- `earningsReleasesOnly` (boolean): true = only 8-Ks with Item 2.02 (Results of Operations and Financial Condition): the dates and exact times companies released earnings. Overrides `formTypes` and `itemCodes`. Default false.
- `itemCodes` (array): Only 8-Ks reporting at least one of these items, as strings, e.g. ["5.02"] (director/officer change), "1.01" (material agreement), "2.01" (acquisition), "1.05" (cybersecurity incident). Without `formTypes`, reads 8-K and 8-K/A. Empty = no item filter.
- `dateFrom` (string): Earliest filing date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2020-01-01". EDGAR's index goes back to 1993. Empty = `lookbackDays` days before today (or, for tickers/CIKs without `lookbackDays`, the company's newest filings).
- `dateTo` (string): Latest filing date, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty = today, including filings accepted minutes ago (live EDGAR feed).
- `lookbackDays` (integer): Used only when `dateFrom` is empty: read filings from this many days back until today, e.g. 365. Empty = 7 days for the whole market; for `tickers`/`ciks`, empty = each company's newest filings (its last 1,000), so "latest 10-K of AAPL" needs no dates.
- `maxResults` (integer): Maximum filings, newest first, e.g. 10 for a company's latest 10 filings. Default 100. The run stops once it has this many; you pay per filing returned.
- `onlyNewSinceLastRun` (boolean): true = skip (and don't charge for) filings an earlier run with the same filters already delivered. For scheduled runs. Default false. Remembered in a named key-value store in your account.

### Output fields

- `schema_version` (string): Output schema version.
- `accession_number` (string): SEC accession number (unique per filing).
- `form` (string): EDGAR form type as filed, e.g. 8-K, 10-K, SC 13D.
- `company_name` (string): Company the filing is about (issuer or subject; the filer otherwise).
- `cik` (string): SEC CIK of that company (10 digits).
- `ticker` (string | null): Its main ticker in the SEC's current ticker list (null if none).
- `filing_date` (string): Filing date (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `accepted_at` (string | null): EDGAR acceptance time, New York time with offset.
- `market_timing` (string | null): before_open, market_hours or after_close (New York regular session), closed on weekends.
- `report_date` (string | null): Period of report (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. the quarter end of a 10-Q or the event date of an 8-K.
- `items` (array): 8-K item codes, e.g. ["2.02", "9.01"]. Empty for other forms.
- `item_descriptions` (array): Names of those items, same order.
- `parties` (array | null): All companies and people on the filing with their role (Filer, Issuer, Subject, Filed by, Reporting). Null for company searches.
- `filing_index_url` (string): EDGAR filing index page (all documents and exhibits).
- `primary_document_url` (string | null): The main document (HTML/iXBRL, text or XML).
- `source` (string): submissions-api, full-index, daily-index or live-feed.
- `source_url` (string): The SEC page or file the row was read from.
- `retrieved_at` (string): UTC time the row was produced.

### Example input

```json
{ "tickers": ["AAPL", "MSFT", "NVDA"], "formTypes": ["8-K", "10-Q", "10-K"], "dateFrom": "2020-01-01", "maxResults": 1000 }
```

## Congress Stock Trades API: US House STOCK Act since 2014

Docs: https://boscolabs.dev/us-house-trades.html
Apify Store: https://apify.com/bosco_labs/us-house-trades
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/us-house-trades
Price: $0.0018 per trade

Congress stock trades: stock, option, fund and bond trades that US House members disclose in STOCK Act Periodic Transaction Reports, from the Clerk's official filings since 2014 (no Senate). Each row: ticker, amount range, owner, disclosure delay. Filter by member, ticker, type, amount, date.

Coverage: Periodic Transaction Reports of House members filed online, from January 2014 to the latest update of the Clerk's index. Scanned paper PTRs are skipped (their PDF links are listed in the run's SUMMARY record). The Senate and annual financial disclosure reports are not included.

Example questions:

- Which options did Nancy Pelosi's household trade in 2025, and how many days after the trade were they disclosed?
- Which House members disclosed NVDA trades in the last 30 days?
- List House trades over $1 million filed in 2024.

### Input fields

- `members` (array): Case-insensitive part of the member's name as listed by the Clerk, e.g. ["Pelosi"] or ["Josh Gottheimer"]. Empty = all House members.
- `tickers` (array): Only trades whose filing names one of these tickers, e.g. ["NVDA", "MSFT", "BRK.B"]. Trades without a ticker in the filing are left out when this is set. Empty = all.
- `transactionTypes` (array): Any of purchase, sale (full or partial), exchange, e.g. ["purchase"]. Default all three.
- `filedFrom` (string): Earliest filing date (when the trade became public), YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2025-01-01". Empty = 365 days ago when `members` is set, else 30 days ago; ignored when `years` is set without dates.
- `filedTo` (string): Latest filing date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2025-12-31". Empty = today.
- `years` (array): Whole filing years to load, as strings, e.g. ["2024", "2025"] (one Clerk index per year; online PTRs start in 2014). Without dates, returns those whole years. Use this or `filedFrom` for history.
- `minAmountUsd` (integer): Only trades whose reported range starts at or above this USD amount, e.g. 15001 leaves out the smallest $1,001 - $15,000 range, 1000001 keeps trades over $1 million. Empty = no minimum.
- `maxResults` (integer): Maximum trades, newest filings first, e.g. 500. Default 100. You pay per trade returned.
- `onlyNewSinceLastRun` (boolean): true = skip (and don't charge for) trades an earlier run with the same filters already delivered. For scheduled runs. Default false. Remembered in a named key-value store in your account.

### Output fields

- `schema_version` (string): Output schema version.
- `transaction_id` (string): doc_id + position of the transaction in the PTR, e.g. 20035553-1. Stable across runs.
- `member_name` (string): First name, last name and suffix as listed in the Clerk's index.
- `first_name` (string): First name as listed in the Clerk's index.
- `last_name` (string): Last name as listed in the Clerk's index.
- `state_district` (string | null): State and district as listed in the index, e.g. CA11.
- `state` (string | null): Two-letter state code, the first two characters of state_district.
- `filing_date` (string): Date the PTR was filed (YYYY-MM-DD): when the trade became public.
- `transaction_date` (string): Trade date as reported (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `notification_date` (string): Date the member was notified of the trade, as reported (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `days_to_disclose` (integer): filing_date - transaction_date in days. For amendments this counts to the amendment, not the first filing.
- `owner` (string | null): Owner code as filed: SP = spouse, JT = joint, DC = dependent child, null = the member.
- `ticker` (string | null): Ticker as filed in parentheses in the asset text, upper-cased; null when the filing gives none.
- `asset_description` (string): Asset text as filed (older PDFs garble upper/lower case).
- `asset_type` (string | null): From asset_type_code: ST = stock, OP = option, EF/MF = fund, GS/CS = bond, other codes = other. Filings before ~2018 have no code: option if the description says so, else null.
- `asset_type_code` (string | null): The Clerk's asset type code in square brackets, e.g. ST, OP, EF, GS (see fd.house.gov/reference/asset-type-codes.aspx).
- `option_type` (string | null): call or put, from the transaction description, for options only.
- `transaction_type` (string): P = purchase, S / S (partial) = sale, E = exchange.
- `is_partial` (boolean): True for a partial sale (S (partial)).
- `amount_min` (number | null): Lower bound of the reported value range in USD, e.g. 15001; the value itself when the filer reported an exact amount (e.g. 318.74).
- `amount_max` (number | null): Upper bound of the reported value range in USD; null for 'Over $50,000,000' and 'Spouse/DC Over $1,000,000'.
- `amount_text` (string): The value range (or exact value) as filed, e.g. $15,001 - $50,000.
- `is_amendment` (boolean): True when the transaction's filing status is Amended: the filing date is then not when the trade first became public.
- `doc_id` (string): The Clerk's document (filing) ID.
- `pdf_url` (string): The PTR PDF on disclosures-clerk.house.gov.
- `source_url` (string): Where the row was extracted from (the PTR PDF).
- `retrieved_at` (string): UTC time the PDF was fetched and parsed.

### Example input

```json
{ "members": ["Pelosi"], "years": ["2024", "2025"], "transactionTypes": ["purchase"], "maxResults": 500 }
```

## SEC Ownership API: 13F Holdings, 13D/13G Stakes, Form 144

Docs: https://boscolabs.dev/sec-ownership.html
Apify Store: coming soon
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/sec-ownership
Price: $0.0018 per row

Who owns a stock and who is selling, from official SEC filings: a fund's 13F holdings with quarter-over-quarter changes, the funds holding a ticker, 5%+ stakes (13D activist, 13G passive) and Form 144 planned insider sales. One ticker or fund in, small JSON out, a source link per row.

Example questions:

- What did Berkshire Hathaway buy and sell last quarter?
- Which funds hold the most Nvidia stock?
- Has anyone filed an activist 13D on Peraso?
- Which insiders filed to sell more than $1 million of stock this week?

### Input fields

- `mode` (string): holdings13f = Form 13F: pass `filer` for a fund manager's holdings (with changes vs the previous quarter), or `ticker`/`cusip` for the funds holding a stock. stakes13dg = Schedule 13D/13G filings about `ticker`, or new 13D filings market-wide. planned144 = Form 144 notices of planned insider sales for `ticker`, or market-wide. Default holdings13f.
- `filer` (string): holdings13f only: the fund manager's name or SEC CIK, e.g. "Berkshire Hathaway" or "1067983". A name is matched with EDGAR's company search (the first match that files 13F reports); a CIK is exact. Empty = look up the holders of `ticker`/`cusip` instead.
- `ticker` (string): The company the shares are in, as a current US ticker, e.g. "AAPL". holdings13f: the funds holding it (or, with `filer`, only that position). stakes13dg / planned144: filings about it. Empty = whole market (stakes13dg, planned144).
- `issuerCik` (string): Instead of `ticker`: the company's SEC CIK as digits, e.g. "320193" for Apple. Use for delisted or renamed companies. Empty = use `ticker`.
- `cusip` (string): holdings13f only: the 9-character CUSIP of one share class, e.g. "037833100" (Apple common stock). Most precise way to ask which funds hold a security. Empty = CUSIPs found in the company's recent Schedule 13D/13G filings (all its share classes).
- `quarter` (string): holdings13f only: the quarter of the holdings, as "2026Q2" or the quarter end "2026-06-30". Empty = the newest: the filer's latest 13F, or for holders of a stock the newest quarter in the SEC's Form 13F data sets (13F reports are due 45 days after quarter end).
- `stakeForms` (array): stakes13dg only: which forms, e.g. ["13D"] for new activist stakes only. Empty = all four for a ticker; 13D and 13D/A for the whole market (activist alerts).
- `minValueUsd` (integer): Minimum value in US dollars, e.g. 1000000. planned144: the notice's aggregate market value; holdings13f: the position value. Default 0 = no minimum. Not used by stakes13dg.
- `dateFrom` (string): stakes13dg / planned144: earliest filing date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-10-01". Structured 13D/13G start 2024-12-18. Empty = `lookbackDays` before today.
- `dateTo` (string): stakes13dg / planned144: latest filing date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-10-31". Empty = today, including today's filings from the EDGAR live feed.
- `lookbackDays` (integer): stakes13dg / planned144, used when `dateFrom` is empty: filings from this many days back until today, e.g. 30. Empty = 365 days for a ticker's 13D/13G, 90 for a ticker's Form 144, 7 for the whole market.
- `maxResults` (integer): Maximum rows (one charged event each), e.g. 200. Default 50: a fund's largest positions, a stock's largest holders, or the newest filings.

### Output fields

- `schema_version` (string): Output schema version.
- `record_type` (string): holding = a position in one 13F filer's portfolio; holder = one 13F filer holding the asked stock (SEC Form 13F data set); stake = one Schedule 13D/13G filing; form144 = one Form 144 notice.
- `form` (string): Form as filed: 13F-HR or 13F-HR/A; 13D, 13D/A, 13G or 13G/A (Schedule); 144 or 144/A.
- `filer_name` (string | null): holding/holder: the 13F manager. stake: the first reporting person on the filing.
- `filer_cik` (string | null): SEC CIK (10 digits) of the 13F manager, of the 13D/13G filer, or of the person filing the Form 144.
- `period_of_report` (string): 13F rows: the quarter end the holdings are reported for (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `accession_number` (string): SEC accession number of the filing the row comes from.
- `filing_date` (string): Date the SEC received the filing (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `issuer_name` (string | null): Company whose securities are held, owned or to be sold, as written in the filing (13F names are often abbreviated).
- `issuer_cik` (string | null): stake/form144: SEC CIK (10 digits) of the issuer.
- `title_of_class` (string | null): 13F rows: class of the security as filed, e.g. COM, CL A, CAP STK CL C.
- `cusip` (string): 13F rows: 9-character CUSIP of the security.
- `cusips` (array): stake: the issuer CUSIP(s) on the cover page.
- `ticker` (string | null): Ticker of this security from the SEC's ticker list: the issuer by CIK or name, the share class by CUSIP or the class in title_of_class (GOOG for Alphabet class C). Null when unknown, or when the issuer has several share classes and the class can't be told (see ticker_candidates).
- `ticker_candidates` (array): When ticker is null because the issuer has several listed share classes: the issuer's tickers, main first (e.g. ["BRK-B", "BRK-A"]). Empty otherwise. Ticker filters match these too.
- `put_call` (string | null): 13F rows: PUT or CALL for option positions (value = the underlying), null for shares and bonds.
- `shares` (number | null): 13F rows: shares (or principal amount when share_type is PRN) held at quarter end, summed over the filing's lines; 0 for a closed position. stake: shares beneficially owned by the reporting person with the highest percent.
- `share_type` (string | null): 13F rows: SH (shares) or PRN (principal amount).
- `value_usd` (number | null): 13F rows: market value in US dollars at quarter end as reported (filings before 2023-01-03 reported $1,000s and are multiplied by 1,000).
- `portfolio_pct` (number | null): holding: value as a percentage of the filing's total reported value.
- `previous_period` (string | null): holding: the previous quarter end the change is measured against.
- `previous_shares` (number | null): holding: shares at the previous quarter end (0 = not held then, null = no 13F for that quarter).
- `previous_value_usd` (number | null): holding: value at the previous quarter end, in US dollars.
- `shares_change` (number | null): holding: shares minus previous_shares.
- `shares_change_pct` (number | null): holding: shares_change as a percentage of previous_shares (null when not held before).
- `change` (string | null): holding: new, increased, decreased, unchanged or closed (sold out) vs the previous quarter; null when unknown.
- `stake_type` (string | null): stake: activist (Schedule 13D: may seek to influence control) or passive (Schedule 13G).
- `amendment_no` (integer | null): stake: amendment number on the cover page (null for an original filing).
- `security_class` (string | null): stake/form144: class of securities as filed, e.g. Common Stock.
- `percent_of_class` (number | null): stake: percent of the class beneficially owned, the highest among the reporting persons (group members usually report the same aggregate).
- `reporting_persons` (array): stake: every reporting person on the cover pages: name, cik (null if none), percent_of_class, shares, person_type (SEC codes like IA, IN, PN, CO).
- `event_date` (string | null): stake: date of the event that required the filing (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `seller_name` (string | null): form144: the person for whose account the securities are to be sold, as filed.
- `relationships` (array): form144: relationship to the issuer as filed, e.g. Director, Officer, 10% Securityholder.
- `shares_to_be_sold` (number | null): form144: number of shares (units) to be sold, summed over the notice's lines.
- `aggregate_market_value_usd` (number | null): form144: aggregate market value of the shares to be sold, in US dollars, as filed.
- `shares_outstanding` (number | null): form144: shares of the class outstanding, as filed.
- `approx_sale_date` (string | null): form144: approximate date of sale (YYYY-MM-DD; the earliest if several).
- `exchanges` (array): form144: exchange(s) where the shares are to be sold.
- `broker_names` (array): form144: broker(s) or market maker(s) handling the sale.
- `plan_adoption_dates` (array): form144: adoption dates of the Rule 10b5-1 trading plan, if the sale is under one (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `notice_date` (string | null): form144: date of the notice (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `filing_url` (string): EDGAR index page of the filing.
- `source` (string): edgar-13f (the filing's information table), sec-13f-data-set (SEC Form 13F data set) or edgar-xml (the filing's XML).
- `source_url` (string): The exact SEC file the row was read from.
- `retrieved_at` (string): UTC time the row was produced.

### Example input

```json
{"mode": "holdings13f", "filer": "Berkshire Hathaway"}
```

## SEC Company Financials API: income, balance sheet, cash flow

Docs: https://boscolabs.dev/sec-company-financials.html
Apify Store: coming soon
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/sec-company-financials
Price: $0.005 per company-period row
API: POST https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/sec-company-financials, $0.005 per company-period row (max 10 tickers/CIKs x 20 years)

US company financials from SEC XBRL: revenue, profit, EPS, balance sheet, cash flow, free cash flow and margins per fiscal year or quarter, 2009 to today. By ticker or CIK, 10-K/10-Q and 20-F filers. Each value cites its XBRL tag and SEC filing. Q4 derived where not reported.

Example questions:

- How did Microsoft's revenue, net income and free cash flow develop over the last 8 quarters?
- Compare Nvidia, AMD and Intel on operating margin for the last 5 fiscal years.
- What was JPMorgan's net income in 2024, and which filing is it from?

### Input fields

- `tickers` (array): US tickers as listed by the SEC, e.g. ["AAPL", "MSFT"]; share classes with a dash or dot, e.g. "BRK-B". Foreign companies filing 20-F/40-F work too, e.g. "NVO". Mapped to the CIK with the SEC's company_tickers.json; an unknown ticker is skipped with suggestions in the status message. Empty = use `ciks`.
- `ciks` (array): SEC Central Index Keys as digits, leading zeros optional, e.g. ["320193"] for Apple. Use for delisted companies and filers without a ticker. Empty = use `tickers`; at least one of the two is required.
- `period` (string): "annual" = one row per fiscal year (FY). "quarterly" = one row per fiscal quarter, Q1-Q4, each a discrete 3-month period (Q4 and year-to-date-only cash flows are derived, see `warnings`). Companies without quarterly XBRL data (most 20-F filers) return fiscal years instead. Default "annual".
- `years` (integer): How many of the latest fiscal years to return per company, e.g. 5 (5 rows annual, up to 20 rows quarterly; 2 with quarterly = the last 8 quarters). XBRL data starts in 2009-2011. Default 5, max 20.
- `metrics` (array): Only these output fields, e.g. ["revenue", "net_income", "free_cash_flow", "operating_margin"]. Valid: revenue, cost_of_revenue, gross_profit, research_and_development, selling_general_and_administrative, operating_profit, profit_before_tax, net_income, net_income_attributable_to_parent, eps_basic, eps_diluted, weighted_average_shares_basic, weighted_average_shares_diluted, depreciation_amortisation, total_assets, current_assets, cash_and_equivalents, total_liabilities, current_liabilities, noncurrent_liabilities, long_term_debt, total_equity, equity_attributable_to_parent, shares_outstanding, operating_cash_flow, investing_cash_flow, financing_cash_flow, capex, dividends_paid, free_cash_flow, ebitda, gross_margin, operating_margin, net_margin, return_on_equity, equity_ratio, revenue_growth. Empty = all of them.
- `includeSources` (boolean): true = each row has `sources` (per value: the XBRL tag and the SEC accession number it came from, plus how it was derived) and `filings` (form, filing date and URL of each filing cited). false = values only, about 3x smaller rows. Default true.

### Output fields

- `schema_version` (string): Output schema version.
- `ticker` (string | null): Main ticker in the SEC's current ticker list (null if none).
- `cik` (string): SEC CIK, 10 digits.
- `company_name` (string): Company name as in SEC companyfacts.
- `fiscal_year` (integer): Fiscal year as the company names it (Apple's year ending September 2025 = 2025).
- `fiscal_period` (string): FY for a fiscal year, Q1-Q4 for a discrete 3-month fiscal quarter.
- `period_start` (string | null): First day of the period (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `period_end` (string): Last day of the period = balance-sheet date (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `form` (string | null): Form of the main filing for this period: 10-K, 10-Q, 20-F, 40-F, 6-K or an /A amendment.
- `filed` (string | null): Filing date of that filing (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `accession_number` (string | null): SEC accession number of the filing most values come from.
- `source_url` (string | null): EDGAR index page of that filing.
- `currency` (string): Reporting currency of all money values (ISO 4217, e.g. USD, EUR, DKK). Values are in full units, not thousands.
- `revenue` (number | null): Total revenue / net sales (for banks: total net revenue). In `currency`.
- `cost_of_revenue` (number | null): Cost of revenue / cost of goods and services sold. In `currency`.
- `gross_profit` (number | null): Gross profit; when not tagged, revenue - cost_of_revenue (sources says derived). In `currency`.
- `research_and_development` (number | null): Research and development expense. In `currency`.
- `selling_general_and_administrative` (number | null): Selling, general and administrative expense (null when the company reports sales/marketing and G&A separately). In `currency`.
- `operating_profit` (number | null): Operating income (loss). Null for most banks and insurers. In `currency`.
- `profit_before_tax` (number | null): Income from continuing operations before income taxes. In `currency`.
- `net_income` (number | null): Net income including noncontrolling interests (ProfitLoss), else net income attributable to the parent; as in the esef-annual-reports Actor. In `currency`.
- `net_income_attributable_to_parent` (number | null): Net income attributable to the parent's shareholders (the US 'net income' headline). In `currency`.
- `eps_basic` (number | null): Basic earnings per share, in currency per share. Never derived (null for Q4 unless reported).
- `eps_diluted` (number | null): Diluted earnings per share, in currency per share. Never derived.
- `weighted_average_shares_basic` (number | null): Weighted average shares outstanding, basic. Never derived.
- `weighted_average_shares_diluted` (number | null): Weighted average shares outstanding, diluted. Never derived.
- `depreciation_amortisation` (number | null): Depreciation, depletion and amortization (cash flow statement). In `currency`.
- `total_assets` (number | null): Total assets at period end. In `currency`.
- `current_assets` (number | null): Total current assets at period end. Null for banks and insurers (unclassified balance sheet). In `currency`.
- `cash_and_equivalents` (number | null): Cash and cash equivalents at period end (banks: cash and due from banks). In `currency`.
- `total_liabilities` (number | null): Total liabilities; when not tagged, total_assets - total_equity (sources says derived). In `currency`.
- `current_liabilities` (number | null): Total current liabilities. Null for banks and insurers. In `currency`.
- `noncurrent_liabilities` (number | null): Total non-current liabilities, when tagged. In `currency`.
- `long_term_debt` (number | null): Long-term debt, non-current portion where tagged, else total long-term debt; sources shows the tag. In `currency`.
- `total_equity` (number | null): Total equity including noncontrolling interests, else stockholders' equity. In `currency`.
- `equity_attributable_to_parent` (number | null): Stockholders' equity attributable to the parent. In `currency`.
- `shares_outstanding` (number | null): Common shares outstanding at the balance-sheet date.
- `operating_cash_flow` (number | null): Net cash from operating activities. In `currency`.
- `investing_cash_flow` (number | null): Net cash from investing activities. In `currency`.
- `financing_cash_flow` (number | null): Net cash from financing activities. In `currency`.
- `capex` (number | null): Capital expenditure: payments for property, plant and equipment, as a positive number. Null for most banks. In `currency`.
- `dividends_paid` (number | null): Dividends paid in cash, as a positive number. In `currency`.
- `free_cash_flow` (number | null): Derived: operating_cash_flow - capex.
- `ebitda` (number | null): Derived: operating_profit + depreciation_amortisation.
- `gross_margin` (number | null): Derived: gross_profit / revenue (0.25 = 25%).
- `operating_margin` (number | null): Derived: operating_profit / revenue.
- `net_margin` (number | null): Derived: net_income / revenue.
- `return_on_equity` (number | null): Derived: net_income / total_equity, fiscal-year rows only.
- `equity_ratio` (number | null): Derived: total_equity / total_assets.
- `revenue_growth` (number | null): Derived: revenue / revenue of the same fiscal period one year earlier - 1 (year over year, also for quarters).
- `metrics_found` (integer): How many of the reported metrics (not the derived ones) have a value.
- `sources` (object): Only with includeSources: per metric {tag: XBRL concept used, accession: filing it came from, derived: how a quarter value was computed (e.g. 'fiscal year - 9-month YTD') or the formula for gross_profit/total_liabilities fallbacks}.
- `filings` (object): Only with includeSources: per accession number cited in sources, its form, filing date and EDGAR URL.
- `warnings` (array): Notes on this row: quarter values derived from year-to-date figures, restated values (latest filing used), quarterly data missing.
- `retrieved_at` (string): UTC time the row was produced.

### Example input

```json
{ "tickers": ["AAPL", "MSFT"], "period": "quarterly", "years": 2, "metrics": ["revenue", "net_income", "free_cash_flow"] }
```

## SEC Company Screener API: filter all US filers by financials

Docs: https://boscolabs.dev/sec-company-screen.html
Apify Store: coming soon
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/sec-company-screen
Price: $0.002 per company returned
API: POST https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/sec-company-screen, $0.002 per company returned (max 200 companies (maxResults))

US companies matching your filters for one calendar year or quarter: revenue, net income, margins, cash flow, assets and 30 more metrics from SEC XBRL frames, sorted and capped. Each value cites its XBRL tag and SEC filing. Same metrics as SEC Company Financials.

Example questions:

- Which US companies had revenue over $10B and net margin above 20% in fiscal 2025?
- Top 20 US companies by operating cash flow in 2025.
- Which companies with a ticker had an operating margin above 30% in Q3 2025?

### Input fields

- `period` (string, required): Calendar period in SEC frames format: "CY2025" = annual figures, "CY2025Q3" = 3-month quarter figures. Required, 2009 to the current year. Calendar-aligned: each company comes with its own fiscal period that best fits it (e.g. CY2025 holds Apple's fiscal year to Sep 2025, Microsoft's to Jun 2025, Walmart's to Jan 2026), shown in period_start/period_end. Balance-sheet metrics are taken at each company's period end.
- `filters` (array): Conditions every company must meet, as a list of {metric, min, max} (either bound optional, both inclusive), e.g. [{"metric": "revenue", "min": 10000000000}, {"metric": "net_margin", "min": 0.2}] = revenue of at least $10B and net margin of at least 20%. Money in full USD (10000000000 = $10B), ratios as fractions (0.2 = 20%), EPS in USD per share. A company without a value for a filter metric is left out. Metrics: see sortBy. Empty = no filter (all companies with a sortBy value).
- `sortBy` (string): Metric to rank by, e.g. "operating_cash_flow". Same names as the SEC Company Financials Actor; the last seven (free_cash_flow to equity_ratio) are derived from two reported metrics. Companies without a value for it are left out. Empty = the first filter's metric, else revenue.
- `sortOrder` (string): "desc" = largest first (top N), "asc" = smallest first (e.g. the lowest net margin). Default "desc".
- `maxResults` (integer): Most companies to return (and charge for), e.g. 20 for a top 20. The status message says how many matched in total. Default 50, max 1000.
- `metrics` (array): More fields to show per company besides the sortBy and filter metrics, e.g. ["operating_cash_flow", "total_assets"]. Same names as sortBy. Each adds a few SEC requests. Empty = only the sortBy and filter metrics (plus the inputs of derived ones).
- `tickersOnly` (boolean): true = skip companies without a ticker in the SEC's company_tickers.json (delisted companies, private issuers of public debt, subsidiaries). Default false.
- `includeSources` (boolean): true = each row has `sources`: per value the XBRL tag, the SEC accession number and the filing URL (or the formula for derived values). false = values only, about 3x smaller rows. Default true.

### Output fields

- `schema_version` (string): Output schema version.
- `ticker` (string | null): Main ticker in the SEC's current ticker list (null if the company has none, e.g. delisted or private debt issuers).
- `cik` (string): SEC CIK, 10 digits.
- `company_name` (string | null): Company name as in the SEC frame.
- `period` (string): The calendar period screened, e.g. CY2025 or CY2025Q3. SEC frames are calendar-aligned: each company appears with its own fiscal period that best fits this calendar period (Apple's year to 27 Sep 2025, Microsoft's to 30 Jun 2025 and Walmart's to 31 Jan 2026 are all in CY2025). See period_start/period_end.
- `period_start` (string | null): First day of the company's own fiscal period that SEC assigned to this calendar period (YYYY-MM-DD); null when the company reported no duration value (income, cash flow or EPS) for it.
- `period_end` (string | null): Last day of that fiscal period (YYYY-MM-DD); balance-sheet values are as of this date (when period_start is null: the balance-sheet date nearest the calendar period's end).
- `currency` (string): Always USD: frames are screened in USD (companies reporting in other currencies are not included). Values are in full dollars, not thousands.
- `revenue` (number | null): Total revenue / net sales (for banks: total net revenue). In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `cost_of_revenue` (number | null): Cost of revenue / cost of goods and services sold. In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `gross_profit` (number | null): Gross profit; when not tagged, revenue - cost_of_revenue (sources says derived). In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `research_and_development` (number | null): Research and development expense. In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `selling_general_and_administrative` (number | null): Selling, general and administrative expense (null when the company reports sales/marketing and G&A separately). In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `operating_profit` (number | null): Operating income (loss). Null for most banks and insurers. In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `profit_before_tax` (number | null): Income from continuing operations before income taxes. In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `net_income` (number | null): Net income including noncontrolling interests (ProfitLoss), else net income attributable to the parent; as in the esef-annual-reports Actor. In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `net_income_attributable_to_parent` (number | null): Net income attributable to the parent's shareholders (the US 'net income' headline). In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `eps_basic` (number | null): Basic earnings per share, in USD per share. Never derived (null for Q4 unless reported). Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `eps_diluted` (number | null): Diluted earnings per share, in USD per share. Never derived. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `weighted_average_shares_basic` (number | null): Weighted average shares outstanding, basic. Never derived. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `weighted_average_shares_diluted` (number | null): Weighted average shares outstanding, diluted. Never derived. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `depreciation_amortisation` (number | null): Depreciation, depletion and amortization (cash flow statement). In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `total_assets` (number | null): Total assets at period end. In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `current_assets` (number | null): Total current assets at period end. Null for banks and insurers (unclassified balance sheet). In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `cash_and_equivalents` (number | null): Cash and cash equivalents at period end (banks: cash and due from banks). In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `total_liabilities` (number | null): Total liabilities; when not tagged, total_assets - total_equity (sources says derived). In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `current_liabilities` (number | null): Total current liabilities. Null for banks and insurers. In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `noncurrent_liabilities` (number | null): Total non-current liabilities, when tagged. In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `long_term_debt` (number | null): Long-term debt, non-current portion where tagged, else total long-term debt; sources shows the tag. In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `total_equity` (number | null): Total equity including noncontrolling interests, else stockholders' equity. In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `equity_attributable_to_parent` (number | null): Stockholders' equity attributable to the parent. In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `shares_outstanding` (number | null): Common shares outstanding at the balance-sheet date. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `operating_cash_flow` (number | null): Net cash from operating activities. In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `investing_cash_flow` (number | null): Net cash from investing activities. In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `financing_cash_flow` (number | null): Net cash from financing activities. In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `capex` (number | null): Capital expenditure: payments for property, plant and equipment, as a positive number. Null for most banks. In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `dividends_paid` (number | null): Dividends paid in cash, as a positive number. In USD. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `free_cash_flow` (number | null): Derived: operating_cash_flow - capex. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `ebitda` (number | null): Derived: operating_profit + depreciation_amortisation. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `gross_margin` (number | null): Derived: gross_profit / revenue (0.25 = 25%). Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `operating_margin` (number | null): Derived: operating_profit / revenue (0.25 = 25%). Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `net_margin` (number | null): Derived: net_income / revenue (0.25 = 25%). Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `return_on_equity` (number | null): Derived: net_income / total_equity (0.25 = 25%). Calendar-year periods only. Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `equity_ratio` (number | null): Derived: total_equity / total_assets (0.25 = 25%). Only present when asked (sortBy, filters, metrics) or needed for a derived field.
- `sources` (object): Only with includeSources: per metric {tag: XBRL concept used, accession: SEC filing the value comes from (the latest filing that reported it, or for re-checked values the first 10-K/10-Q that did), url: its EDGAR index page}, or {derived: formula} for derived values.
- `warnings` (array): Notes on this row: a value from a proxy statement replaced by the 10-K/10-Q figure, a value that could not be checked, or a metric left out because it was reported for a different period than the row's.
- `retrieved_at` (string): UTC time the row was produced.

### Example input

```json
{
  "period": "CY2025",
  "filters": [
    { "metric": "revenue", "min": 10000000000 },
    { "metric": "net_margin", "min": 0.2 }
  ],
  "sortBy": "revenue",
  "maxResults": 50
}
```

## EU Annual Reports API (ESEF): XBRL financial statements

Docs: https://boscolabs.dev/esef-annual-reports.html
Apify Store: https://apify.com/bosco_labs/esef-annual-reports
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/esef-annual-reports
Price: $0.01 per run plus $0.05 per annual report; raw XBRL fact rows, if switched on, $0.0005 each

Key financials (revenue, EBIT, net income, EPS, assets, equity, cash flows, margins, growth) from ESEF annual reports of European listed companies in 28 countries, via filings.xbrl.org. Each value links to its XBRL fact. Filter by LEI, company name, country and fiscal year end.

Coverage: ESEF annual reports collected by filings.xbrl.org: 27,626 reports from 28 countries (counted 2026-11-05; largest: UA, GB, DK, SE, NO, FR, FI). Germany is not in the index. Reports appear a few days to a few weeks after publication, once filings.xbrl.org has processed them. All values are in full currency units.

Example questions:

- Get Heineken's latest revenue growth and operating margin from its annual report.
- Compare net income and equity of Belgian listed companies for fiscal years ending in 2024.
- Which XBRL fact does ASML's reported revenue come from?

### Input fields

- `leis` (array): Legal Entity Identifiers (20 letters/digits), e.g. ["724500Y6DUVHQD6OXN27"] for ASML: the most precise lookup, any country. Empty = no LEI filter.
- `companyName` (string): Case-insensitive part of the registered company name, e.g. "heineken" or "lvmh"; can match several companies, so check `company_name` in the output. Empty = no name filter.
- `countries` (array): Filing countries as ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes, e.g. ["NL", "BE", "FR"]; also SE, DK, FI, NO, IT, ES, GB and others. Empty = all 28 countries in the index (Germany is not in it).
- `periodFrom` (string): Fiscal year ending on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2024-01-01". Empty = no lower limit.
- `periodTo` (string): Fiscal year ending on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2024-12-31". Empty = no upper limit.
- `maxFilings` (integer): Maximum annual reports, newest fiscal period first, e.g. 1 for a company's latest report. Default 10. One report per company per fiscal year, with the prior year nested in each row.
- `includeRawFacts` (boolean): true = also output every tagged XBRL fact of each report as its own row (record_type = "fact"), charged per fact row. Default false (one summary row per report).
- `onlyNewSinceLastRun` (boolean): true = skip (and don't charge for) reports an earlier run with the same filters already delivered. For scheduled runs. Default false. Remembered in a named key-value store in your account.

### Output fields

- `schema_version` (string): Output schema version.
- `record_type` (string): summary = one row per annual report; fact = one raw XBRL fact (only with includeRawFacts).
- `lei` (string): Legal Entity Identifier of the filer.
- `company_name` (string): Registered name.
- `country` (string): Filing country (ISO 3166 alpha-2).
- `period_end` (string): Fiscal year end (YYYY-MM-DD), taken from the report facts.
- `fiscal_year_start` (string | null): Fiscal year start (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `currency` (string | null): ISO 4217 currency of the monetary values.
- `revenue` (number | null): revenue for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:Revenue or ifrs-full:RevenueFromContractsWithCustomers
- `gross_profit` (number | null): gross_profit for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:GrossProfit
- `operating_profit` (number | null): operating_profit for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:ProfitLossFromOperatingActivities
- `profit_before_tax` (number | null): profit_before_tax for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:ProfitLossBeforeTax
- `net_income` (number | null): net_income for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:ProfitLoss
- `net_income_attributable_to_parent` (number | null): net_income_attributable_to_parent for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:ProfitLossAttributableToOwnersOfParent
- `eps_basic` (number | null): eps_basic for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:BasicEarningsLossPerShare
- `eps_diluted` (number | null): eps_diluted for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:DilutedEarningsLossPerShare
- `total_assets` (number | null): total_assets for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:Assets
- `current_assets` (number | null): current_assets for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:CurrentAssets
- `cash_and_equivalents` (number | null): cash_and_equivalents for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:CashAndCashEquivalents
- `total_equity` (number | null): total_equity for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:Equity
- `equity_attributable_to_parent` (number | null): equity_attributable_to_parent for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:EquityAttributableToOwnersOfParent
- `total_liabilities` (number | null): total_liabilities for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:Liabilities
- `current_liabilities` (number | null): current_liabilities for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:CurrentLiabilities
- `noncurrent_liabilities` (number | null): noncurrent_liabilities for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:NoncurrentLiabilities
- `operating_cash_flow` (number | null): operating_cash_flow for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:CashFlowsFromUsedInOperatingActivities
- `investing_cash_flow` (number | null): investing_cash_flow for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:CashFlowsFromUsedInInvestingActivities
- `financing_cash_flow` (number | null): financing_cash_flow for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:CashFlowsFromUsedInFinancingActivities
- `depreciation_amortisation` (number | null): depreciation_amortisation for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:DepreciationAndAmortisationExpense or ifrs-full:AdjustmentsForDepreciationAndAmortisationExpense or ifrs-full:DepreciationAmortisationAndImpairmentLossReversalOfImpairmentLossRecognisedInProfitOrLoss or ifrs-full:AdjustmentsForDepreciationAndAmortisationExpenseAndImpairmentLossReversalOfImpairmentLossRecognisedInProfitOrLoss
- `employee_benefits_expense` (number | null): employee_benefits_expense for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:EmployeeBenefitsExpense
- `dividends_paid` (number | null): dividends_paid for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:DividendsPaidClassifiedAsFinancingActivities or ifrs-full:DividendsPaid
- `dividend_per_share` (number | null): dividend_per_share for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:DividendsRecognisedAsDistributionsToOwnersPerShare
- `dividend_proposed_per_share` (number | null): dividend_proposed_per_share for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:DividendsProposedOrDeclaredBeforeFinancialStatementsAuthorisedForIssueButNotRecognisedAsDistributionToOwnersPerShare
- `shares_outstanding` (number | null): shares_outstanding for the fiscal year; source concept: ifrs-full:NumberOfSharesOutstanding
- `metrics_found` (integer): How many of the reported metrics were found.
- `ebitda` (number | null): Derived: operating_profit + depreciation_amortisation.
- `operating_margin` (number | null): Derived: operating_profit / revenue.
- `net_margin` (number | null): Derived: net_income / revenue.
- `return_on_equity` (number | null): Derived: net_income / total_equity.
- `equity_ratio` (number | null): Derived: total_equity / total_assets.
- `revenue_growth` (number | null): Derived: revenue / prior_year.revenue - 1.
- `sources` (object): Per field: concept, fact_id, period, unit, decimals of the source fact, or {derived: formula}.
- `prior_year` (object | null): Comparative fiscal year from the same report: period_end, fiscal_year_start, currency, the same metrics and derived fields, metrics_found and sources.
- `fact_id` (string): XBRL fact id inside the report.
- `concept` (string): XBRL concept, e.g. ifrs-full:Revenue.
- `value` (string | null): Raw fact value as reported (canonical form).
- `unit` (string | null): XBRL unit, e.g. iso4217:EUR.
- `period` (string | null): XBRL period (instant or start/end).
- `decimals` (integer | null): XBRL decimals (precision).
- `dimensions` (object): Extra XBRL dimensions (axes/members) of the fact.
- `filing_id` (string): filings.xbrl.org filing id.
- `published` (string | null): Publication timestamp of the filing.
- `viewer_url` (string | null): Inline XBRL viewer of the annual report.
- `report_url` (string | null): The iXBRL (XHTML) annual report.
- `source_url` (string): xBRL-JSON the row was extracted from.
- `retrieved_at` (string): UTC time the source was fetched.

### Example input

```json
{ "countries": ["NL", "BE", "FR"], "periodFrom": "2025-01-01", "maxFilings": 50 }
```

## Company Check API: identity, financials & SEC filings in 1 call

Docs: https://boscolabs.dev/company-check.html
Apify Store: coming soon
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/company-check
Price: $0.03 per report
API: POST https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/company-check, $0.03 per company report (max 1 report)

One company report per call: legal name, LEI, registration number, status, address and industry, years of revenue, profit, equity, assets and cash, SEC filings and FDIC bank data. Look up by name, LEI, UK, DK, NO, FR, FI or EE number, ticker, CIK or FDIC cert. Sourced values.

Example questions:

- Who is Novo Nordisk legally, and what were its revenue and net income in the last three years? Cite your sources.

### Input fields

- `query` (string, required): The company to check: a name (e.g. "Novo Nordisk") or an identifier: LEI (20 characters, e.g. "724500Y6DUVHQD6OXN27"), UK company number ("00445790", "SC123456"), Danish CVR ("24256790"), Norwegian org number ("923609016"), French SIREN (9 digits, "552032534") or SIRET (14 digits, "55203253400703"), Finnish Business ID with its dash ("0112038-9"), Estonian registry code (8 digits, "12417834"), US ticker in capitals or with $ ("AAPL", "$brk.b"; foreign companies listed in the US resolve to their home country), SEC CIK ("320193") or FDIC certificate of a US bank ("FDIC:628"). The type is detected from format and check digits; an 8-digit number valid in several registers (UK, Danish CVR, Estonian) is settled by asking them, and `country` decides when given. Required.
- `country` (string): ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code to disambiguate, e.g. "DK", "GB", "NO", "FR", "FI", "EE", "NL", "US". With a name it limits the search to that country and, for NO, FR, FI and EE, also searches the national register (most companies there have no LEI); with a number it says which register the number belongs to (e.g. "GB" for a UK number without a leading zero, "EE" for an Estonian registry code, "FI" for a Business ID typed without its dash). Empty = detect from the query.
- `maxYears` (integer): How many fiscal years of key figures to return, newest first, e.g. 3. Default 3, maximum 10. Norway's open register holds the last 3 years only. The price is the same for any number of years.
- `include` (array): Which sections to fill: any of "identity", "financials", "us" (SEC filings of US issuers), e.g. ["identity", "financials"]. Default (or empty) = all three. Fewer sections = fewer sources called, slightly faster; the price is the same.

### Output fields

- `schema_version` (string): Output schema version.
- `query` (string): The query as given.
- `query_type` (string): How the query was read: lei, uk (UK company number), cvr, ee (Estonian registry code), orgnr (Norwegian org number), siren (French SIREN, also for a SIRET), ytunnus (Finnish Business ID), fdic (FDIC certificate number), cik, ticker or name.
- `country` (string | null): ISO 3166 alpha-2 country of the company (its home country, also for a foreign company listed in the US). null when unknown.
- `identity` (object | null): Who the company is: from the national register, GLEIF, the SEC and (US banks) the FDIC (first source that has a value wins). null if no source had a record or the section was not requested.
- `financials` (object | null): Key figures of the last `maxYears` fiscal years, each with its source filing: a listed company's ESEF report first, else the national register, else the company's SEC XBRL filings (10-K, 20-F, 40-F). null when none were found (see not_found).
- `us` (object | null): The US listing: SEC EDGAR data for US issuers and for foreign companies listed in the US (by ticker, CIK, or a US company in GLEIF that the SEC lists). null otherwise.
- `bank` (object | null): US banks: the FDIC-insured bank of this company from the FDIC BankFind Suite (company level only). Filled for a US bank (found by FDIC certificate, LEI or name) and for a US bank holding company (its largest bank). Requested with the `us` section. null otherwise.
- `candidates` (array): When a name (or a number valid in two registers) matches several companies: the top 3 (legal_name, country, lei, lei_status, registration_number, score 0-1). The report is for the first; re-run with its LEI or registration number (and country) to pick another. Empty when the match was clear.
- `not_found` (array): Requested sections without data, each {section, reason} in plain words an agent can relay.
- `warnings` (array): Sources that failed or timed out, and other caveats, in plain words. The rest of the report is still valid.
- `sources` (array): Every source used, each {section, name, url}.
- `retrieved_at` (string): When the report was made (ISO 8601, UTC).
- `duration_seconds` (number): How long the lookup took.

### Example input

```json
{ "query": "Novo Nordisk", "country": "DK", "maxYears": 3 }
```

## Company Financials API: UK, Denmark & Norway accounts + LEI

Docs: https://boscolabs.dev/company-accounts.html
Apify Store: https://apify.com/bosco_labs/company-accounts
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/company-accounts
Price: $0.04 per company-year

Company financials (revenue, profit, equity, assets, cash, employees) of private and public companies from official accounts: UK Companies House (all digital years), Denmark (all years), Norway Brønnøysund (last 3 years). Look up by company number, CVR or org number; adds LEI and a source per value.

Coverage: UK: accounts filed electronically with Companies House in the last ~60 days. Denmark: every annual report filed digitally with Erhvervsstyrelsen, all years. Norway: the last 3 fiscal years of every company that files accounts with the Brønnøysund Register (company accounts, not group accounts). Belgium only when the Actor owner has configured access. LEI looked up at GLEIF.

Example questions:
