- What were Novo Nordisk's revenue and equity in its latest Danish annual report?
- Get the last three years of Equinor ASA's own accounts from the Norwegian register.
- What is the LEI and the latest net assets of UK company 03117531?

### Input fields

- `countries` (array): Registers to read, as codes: GB (Companies House), DK (Erhvervsstyrelsen), NO (Brønnøysund Regnskapsregisteret), BE (National Bank of Belgium; needs enterprise numbers and NBB access set up by the Actor owner). Default ["GB", "DK", "NO"]. Used only when no numbers are given (it then returns each country's newest filings); with numbers, the countries of those numbers are read and this is ignored.
- `companyNumbers` (array): UK Companies House numbers, e.g. ["03117531", "SC123456"] (shorter numbers are zero-padded to 8). Accounts of any year filed digitally (iXBRL), newest first; paper/PDF-only filings are skipped. Empty = the newest UK filings (last ~60 days).
- `cvrNumbers` (array): Danish CVR numbers, 8 digits, e.g. ["24256790"]. All years are available, newest first. Empty = the newest Danish filings.
- `orgNumbers` (array): Norwegian organisation numbers, 9 digits, e.g. ["923609016"]. The last 3 fiscal years are available, newest first. Empty = companies whose accounts were registered in the last 2 days.
- `enterpriseNumbers` (array): Belgian KBO/BCE enterprise numbers, 10 digits with or without dots, e.g. ["0403.170.701"]. Required for BE (there is no "newest filings" mode for Belgium), which works only when the Actor owner has set up NBB access.
- `enrichLei` (boolean): true (default) = look up each company's Legal Entity Identifier at GLEIF by its registration number and add `lei` and `lei_status` (null when the company has no LEI). false = skip the lookup.
- `maxResults` (integer): Maximum company-years per country, newest filings first, e.g. 1 for a company's latest accounts. Default 5. One row per company per fiscal year.

### Output fields

- `schema_version` (string): Output schema version.
- `country` (string): Country of the register (ISO 3166 alpha-2).
- `company_number` (string | null): UK Companies House company number (GB rows).
- `cvr` (string | null): Danish CVR number (DK rows).
- `org_number` (string | null): Norwegian organisation number (NO rows).
- `enterprise_number` (string | null): Belgian enterprise (KBO/BCE) number, 10 digits (BE rows).
- `company_name` (string | null): Registered name as tagged in the accounts (NO: from Enhetsregisteret; BE: from the filing reference).
- `lei` (string | null): Legal Entity Identifier found at GLEIF for this registration number; null when none is found or enrichLei is off.
- `lei_status` (string | null): GLEIF registration status of the LEI, e.g. ISSUED or LAPSED.
- `period_end` (string | null): Fiscal year end (YYYY-MM-DD), taken from the facts.
- `fiscal_year_start` (string | null): Fiscal year start (YYYY-MM-DD); null for balance-sheet-only accounts.
- `currency` (string | null): ISO 4217 currency of the monetary values.
- `revenue` (number | null): Turnover / revenue for the fiscal year. Small UK companies (filleted accounts) and Danish class B companies often don't publish it. NO: sales revenue (salgsinntekter), else total operating income.
- `gross_profit` (number | null): Gross profit (DK: bruttofortjeneste, often reported instead of revenue).
- `operating_profit` (number | null): Operating profit (EBIT).
- `profit_before_tax` (number | null): Profit before tax.
- `net_income` (number | null): Profit or loss for the year.
- `total_assets` (number | null): Total assets (DK; UK small-company balance sheets usually don't tag a total).
- `fixed_assets` (number | null): Fixed / non-current assets.
- `current_assets` (number | null): Current assets.
- `cash_and_equivalents` (number | null): Cash at bank and in hand / cash and cash equivalents.
- `total_equity` (number | null): Total equity (capital and reserves).
- `net_assets` (number | null): Net assets (UK balance sheet total).
- `net_current_assets` (number | null): Net current assets or liabilities (UK).
- `total_liabilities` (number | null): Total liabilities; when not tagged, total_assets - total_equity (sources says derived).
- `current_liabilities` (number | null): UK: creditors falling due within one year. DK: short-term liabilities other than provisions. NO: short-term debt. BE: amounts payable within one year.
- `noncurrent_liabilities` (number | null): UK: creditors falling due after more than one year. DK: long-term liabilities other than provisions. NO: long-term debt. BE: amounts payable after more than one year.
- `employees` (number | null): Average number of employees during the year (BE: full-time equivalents). Not in the Norwegian data.
- `metrics_found` (integer): How many of the normalized metrics were found.
- `sources` (object): Per metric: concept, fact_id, context_ref, period, unit, decimals of the source fact, or {derived: formula}. NO: concept is the JSON path in the record at source_url; BE: the NBB rubric code.
- `published` (string | null): GB: filing date (by company number) or date of the Companies House daily file (newest filings); DK: publication timestamp; BE: filing date; NO: null.
- `report_url` (string | null): GB (by company number): the accounts on the Companies House website; DK: the human-readable annual report (XHTML or PDF); NO: PDF copy of the filed accounts at Brønnøysund.
- `registry_url` (string | null): Company page in the official register (filing history / CVR).
- `source_document` (string | null): GB: Companies House filing transaction id (by company number) or file name of the accounts inside the daily bulk ZIP (newest filings).
- `source_url` (string): GB: the Companies House document (by company number, needs a key) or bulk ZIP (newest filings); DK: the XBRL file; NO: the Regnskapsregisteret JSON record; BE: the NBB accounting-data URL (needs a key).
- `retrieved_at` (string): UTC time the source was fetched.

### Example input

```json
{ "countries": ["GB", "DK", "NO"], "companyNumbers": ["03117531"], "cvrNumbers": ["24256790"], "orgNumbers": ["923609016"], "maxResults": 10 }
```

## UK New Companies API: daily Companies House incorporations

Docs: https://boscolabs.dev/uk-new-companies.html
Apify Store: coming soon
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/uk-new-companies
Price: $0.002 per company

New UK companies incorporated on any day (default: yesterday) from the official Companies House API: number, name, type, status, SIC codes with descriptions, registered office address and a register link. Filter by SIC prefix, location and type. No director data.

Example questions:

- New UK companies incorporated yesterday in London with SIC 62 (IT).

### Input fields

- `incorporatedFrom` (string): Earliest incorporation date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-11-01". Empty = the same day as `incorporatedTo` (so both empty = yesterday, UTC).
- `incorporatedTo` (string): Latest incorporation date (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-11-04". Empty = yesterday (UTC), or `incorporatedFrom` if that is later.
- `sicCodes` (array): UK SIC 2007 code prefixes (Companies House condensed list); a prefix matches every code below it, e.g. ["62"] = IT / software, "6201" = software development, "56101" = licensed restaurants, "68" = real estate. A company matches if any of its SIC codes matches. Empty = all sectors.
- `location` (string): Registered office location as free text, passed to Companies House's location filter: a town, county or postcode (area), e.g. "London", "Manchester" or "EC1". Empty = all of the UK.
- `companyTypes` (array): Companies House company types, e.g. ["ltd"] (private limited), "plc", "llp", "private-limited-guarant-nsc" (company limited by guarantee), "limited-partnership". Default ["ltd", "plc", "llp"]. Pass [] for all types.
- `maxResults` (integer): Maximum companies to return, e.g. 500. Default 100. You pay per company delivered.
- `onlyNewSinceLastRun` (boolean): true = skip (and don't charge for) companies an earlier run with the same filters already delivered. For scheduled runs. Default false. Remembered in a named key-value store in your account.

### Output fields

- `schema_version` (string): Output schema version.
- `company_number` (string): Companies House company number, 8 characters, e.g. 16812345 or SC812345.
- `company_name` (string): Registered company name.
- `company_type` (string): Companies House company type code, e.g. ltd, plc, llp.
- `company_subtype` (string | null): Subtype when set: community-interest-company or private-fund-limited-partnership.
- `company_status` (string): Company status code, e.g. active.
- `incorporation_date` (string): Date of incorporation (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `sic_codes` (array): SIC 2007 codes the company declared (up to four, 5 digits).
- `sic_descriptions` (array): Description of each SIC code from the Companies House condensed SIC list, in the same order as sic_codes; null for a code not on that list.
- `registered_office_address` (string | null): Registered office address as one line.
- `address_line_1` (string | null): Registered office: first address line.
- `address_line_2` (string | null): Registered office: second address line.
- `locality` (string | null): Registered office: town or city.
- `region` (string | null): Registered office: region or county, as filed (often empty).
- `postal_code` (string | null): Registered office: postcode.
- `postcode_area` (string | null): Postcode area (leading letters of the postcode), e.g. EC, M, SW.
- `country` (string | null): Registered office: country, e.g. England, Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland.
- `source_url` (string): The company's page on the Companies House register (find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk).
- `api_url` (string): The company profile in the Companies House API (needs an API key).
- `retrieved_at` (string): UTC time the data was fetched.

### Example input

```json
{
  "incorporatedFrom": "2026-11-04",
  "incorporatedTo": "2026-11-04",
  "sicCodes": ["62"],
  "location": "London",
  "companyTypes": ["ltd", "plc", "llp"],
  "maxResults": 100,
  "onlyNewSinceLastRun": false
}
```

## Company Hiring Signals API: open roles, departments, locations

Docs: https://boscolabs.dev/company-hiring-signals.html
Apify Store: coming soon
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/company-hiring-signals
Price: $0.005 per company found plus $0.001 per job row

Is a company hiring? Open roles by department, location and remote share, newest and oldest posting dates and top titles, plus job rows with a link each. Read from the company's public Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby job board. Look up by name, domain or board URL.

Example questions:

- Is Notion hiring engineers? How many roles, where, and since when? Link the postings.

### Input fields

- `companies` (array, required): Companies to check, 1-50: a name ("Notion"), a website domain ("stripe.com"), a job board URL ("https://jobs.lever.co/spotify", "https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/airbnb", "https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ramp") or provider:token ("greenhouse:stripe", "lever:spotify", "lever-eu:<token>", "ashby:notion"). Names and domains are matched to likely board names on Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby; a board URL is exact. Required.
- `departments` (array): Only count and return roles whose department or team has a word starting with one of these, case-insensitive, e.g. ["engineering", "data"]. Department names are each company's own (Stripe uses "Tech" and team codes), so `keywords` on the title is often more reliable. Empty = all departments.
- `locations` (array): Only roles whose location text, other locations or country contains one of these as whole words, case-insensitive ("US" does not match "Australia"), e.g. ["London", "Germany", "remote"]. Lever gives ISO country codes ("GB"), Ashby country names; Greenhouse has the location text only. Empty = all locations.
- `keywords` (array): Only roles whose job title has a word starting with one of these, case-insensitive ("engineer" matches "Engineering", "ai" not "Retail"), e.g. ["engineer", "data scientist"]. Empty = all titles.
- `postedSince` (string): Only roles first published on or after this date: an ISO date ("2026-10-01") or a number of days back ("30d"). Greenhouse: first published; Lever: created; Ashby: last published. Empty = any date.
- `maxJobsPerCompany` (integer): Most job rows to return per company, newest first, e.g. 20. Default 50, maximum 1000; 0 = summary only. The summary always counts all matching roles, whatever this limit. Each job row is charged.
- `summaryOnly` (boolean): true = one summary row per company and no job rows (cheapest; answers "is X hiring and where?"). Default false.
- `compareWithPrevious` (boolean): true = add a `trend` (change in open roles, new and closed jobs) versus the last run that also had this on, and save this run's job IDs for next time in the key-value store "company-hiring-signals-history" in your account. The first run has no trend. Default false.

### Output fields

- `schema_version` (string): Output schema version.
- `row_type` (string): company_summary (one per input company, found or not) or job (one per open role).
- `company` (string): The company as given in the input.
- `found` (boolean | null): Summary rows: true if a public job board was found. Not-found rows are free of charge.
- `provider` (string | null): Job board provider: greenhouse, lever, lever-eu (Lever's EU instance) or ashby.
- `board_token` (string | null): The company's board name at the provider, e.g. stripe. Pass it as provider:token for an exact lookup.
- `board_url` (string | null): Summary rows: the company's public job board page.
- `source_url` (string | null): Summary rows: the public API URL all counts were computed from. Job rows: the job's public posting page.
- `total_open_roles` (integer | null): Summary rows: all open roles on the board, before filters.
- `matching_roles` (integer | null): Summary rows: open roles matching departments, locations, keywords and postedSince. All counts below are over these.
- `filters` (object | null): Summary rows: the filters applied (lower-cased), null if none.
- `by_department` (array): Summary rows: top 15 departments as {name, count}, largest first. Roles without a department are not listed.
- `by_location` (array): Summary rows: top 15 primary locations as written by the company, as {name, count}.
- `by_country` (array): Summary rows: top 15 countries as {name, count}: ISO codes for Lever, country names for Ashby, empty for Greenhouse (no country field).
- `remote_share` (number | null): Summary rows: share of matching roles marked remote, 0-1. Greenhouse: roles whose location text says remote. null when no roles match.
- `posted_last_30_days` (integer | null): Summary rows: matching roles posted in the 30 days before retrieved_at.
- `newest_posted_at` (string | null): Summary rows: newest posting date among matching roles (ISO 8601 UTC).
- `oldest_posted_at` (string | null): Summary rows: oldest posting date among matching roles: how long the company has been hiring for its open roles.
- `top_titles` (array): Summary rows: the 10 most common job titles as {title, count}.
- `trend` (object | null): Summary rows with compareWithPrevious: {previous_retrieved_at, previous_total_open_roles, change, new_jobs, closed_jobs} versus the last such run. null on the first run or when off.
- `jobs_returned` (integer | null): Summary rows: job rows returned for this company (at most maxJobsPerCompany, newest first).
- `other_boards` (array): Summary rows: other boards found for the same name (usually old, smaller ones). The board with most open roles is used.
- `not_found_reason` (string | null): Summary rows: why no board was found, and how to fix it. null when found.
- `warnings` (array): Summary rows: caveats in plain words, e.g. a provider that could not be read or several providers with a board under the same name.
- `job_id` (string | null): Job rows: the provider's job posting ID.
- `title` (string | null): Job rows: job title as published.
- `department` (string | null): Job rows: department (Greenhouse: top-level department).
- `team` (string | null): Job rows: team or sub-department, null if none or the same as department.
- `location` (string | null): Job rows: primary location as written by the company.
- `other_locations` (array): Job rows: further locations of the same posting (Lever, Ashby).
- `country` (string | null): Job rows: country: ISO 3166 alpha-2 for Lever, country name for Ashby, null for Greenhouse.
- `workplace_type` (string | null): Job rows: remote, hybrid or on-site (Lever, Ashby); null when not stated or on Greenhouse.
- `remote` (boolean | null): Job rows: true if remote; false if hybrid or on-site; null when unknown. Greenhouse: true when the location text says remote, else null.
- `employment_type` (string | null): Job rows: as the provider gives it, e.g. FullTime, Intern (Ashby) or Permanent (Lever commitment). null on Greenhouse.
- `posted_at` (string | null): Job rows: ISO 8601 UTC. Greenhouse: first published; Lever: created; Ashby: last published.
- `updated_at` (string | null): Job rows: last update (Greenhouse only), ISO 8601 UTC.
- `retrieved_at` (string): When the board was read (ISO 8601 UTC).

### Example input

```json
{
  "companies": ["stripe.com", "Notion", "https://jobs.lever.co/spotify"],
  "departments": ["engineering"],
  "postedSince": "30d",
  "maxJobsPerCompany": 20
}
```

## Sanctions Screening API: OFAC, UK, EU & US export lists

Docs: https://boscolabs.dev/sanctions-screening.html
Apify Store: coming soon
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/sanctions-screening
Price: $0.01 per name screened
API: POST https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/sanctions-screening, $0.01 per name screened (max 50 names)

Is this company, vessel or person sanctioned? Returns per name: match yes/no, the listed entry, aliases, programs, listing date, identifiers and a source link, from the official OFAC SDN and non-SDN, US Consolidated Screening List, UK Sanctions List and EU lists, with each list's date.

Example questions:

- Before we sign with these suppliers, check whether Sovcomflot or Novo Nordisk A/S are on any sanctions list, and cite the lists you checked.

### Input fields

- `names` (array, required): Company, vessel or person names to check, one per entry, as plain text, e.g. ["Sovcomflot", "Novo Nordisk A/S", "Vladimir Putin"]. Legal forms (Ltd, LLC, GmbH, PJSC), accents, punctuation and word order are ignored. 1-200 names; each name gives one result row and one charge; repeats are screened once. Required.
- `country` (string): Country of the party you are screening, as an ISO 3166 alpha-2 code or English name, e.g. "RU" or "Russia". It never hides a match: listings that name other countries move to the end and get country_match false. Empty = no country ranking.
- `entityType` (string): Only return listings of this type, e.g. "organization". Default "any". Listings whose type the list does not state (the US Commerce and State lists) are always kept.
- `minScore` (integer): Lowest similarity score (0-100) that counts as a match, e.g. 85 (default). 100 = same name after normalisation; 90-99 = small spelling differences or the name inside a longer listed name; lower values find more variants and more false positives. Range 50-100.
- `lists` (array): Which lists to check, any of "ofac_sdn", "ofac_consolidated", "us_csl", "uk", "eu", e.g. ["ofac_sdn", "uk"]. Default (or empty) = all five. The price is the same for any number of lists.

### Output fields

- `schema_version` (string): Output schema version.
- `query` (string): The name as given.
- `match_found` (boolean): True when at least one listing scored >= min_score.
- `match_count` (integer): Number of listings at or above min_score (only the top 5 are in matches).
- `best_score` (integer | null): Highest score, null when nothing matched.
- `summary` (string): One sentence an agent can pass on: the best match, or 'No match >= N' with every list checked and its date.
- `matches` (array): Top 5 listings, best first (listings in other countries than `country` last).
- `lists_checked` (array): Every list this answer covers, with its publish date (version_date), when it was downloaded (fetched_at), its number of entries and the official file URL.
- `warnings` (array): Lists that could not be downloaded (not checked, or checked from an older cached copy), in plain words.
- `min_score` (integer): Threshold used.
- `entity_type` (string): Entity type filter used.
- `country` (string | null): Country used for ranking (ISO-2), or null.
- `checked_at` (string): When the screening ran (ISO 8601, UTC).

### Example input

```json
{ "names": ["Sovcomflot", "Huawei Technologies", "Petrel 8"], "entityType": "any", "minScore": 85 }
```

## EU Law Lookup API (EUR-Lex): article text, in force, amendments

Docs: https://boscolabs.dev/eu-law-lookup.html
Apify Store: coming soon
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/eu-law-lookup
Price: $0.01 per act or article returned
API: POST https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/eu-law-lookup, $0.005 per act or article returned (max 50 results (maxResults))

The text of an EU law article as in force today (or on a date), whether the act is in force, what amended it, plus new Official Journal acts. Ask by name (GDPR, AI Act), citation, CELEX or ELI; 24 languages. Official EUR-Lex/Cellar data with a source link per row.

Example questions:

- What does Article 50 of the AI Act require today, and has it been amended? Quote the text and link the source.

### Input fields

- `query` (string): The EU act to look up: a short name ("GDPR", "AI Act", "DSA", "NIS2", "DORA", "MiCA", "CSRD"...), a citation ("Regulation (EU) 2024/1689", "Directive 95/46/EC", "Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006"), a bare number ("2016/679"), a CELEX number ("32016R0679") or an ELI URI ("http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj"). "AI Act Article 50" also works. Leave empty only when using ojSince (new Official Journal acts). An unreadable citation fails in seconds, with examples, at no charge.
- `article` (string): Article number, optionally with a paragraph: "5", "6(1)", "4a"; several separated by commas ("5, 6(1)", up to 10). One row per article. Empty = one row for the whole act with its table of contents and recital count (no full text unless include has "text").
- `language` (string): EU language code of the text and titles: BG, CS, DA, DE, EL, EN, ES, ET, FI, FR, GA, HR, HU, IT, LT, LV, MT, NL, PL, PT, RO, SK, SL, SV. Default EN. If the text is missing in that language, English is returned with a warning.
- `asOf` (string): YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2025-01-01": return the consolidated version that applied on that date. Empty = today (the newest consolidated version in force now). Acts without consolidated versions return the Official Journal text.
- `include` (array): Any of "metadata" (always on), "amendments" (amended_by, corrected_by, repealed_by, amends, repeals), "citing" (acts and judgments that cite this act, newest first) and "text" (the whole act as plain text, cut at maxTextChars). Default ["metadata", "amendments"]. The price is the same.
- `maxTextChars` (integer): Cap on article_text and text, in characters, e.g. 30000 (default). Longer text is cut and flagged (article_text_truncated / text_truncated) with a warning.
- `maxCiting` (integer): With include "citing": how many citing acts to list, newest first, e.g. 20 (default). citing_acts_total always gives the full count.
- `ojSince` (string): Switches to Official Journal mode: list acts published in the OJ L series from this date (YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-11-03") until today, newest first, at most 31 days back. Leave query empty when you use this. Empty = normal lookup.
- `keywords` (string): OJ mode only: comma-separated words or phrases; an act is kept when its title (in the chosen language) contains any of them, case-insensitive, e.g. "artificial intelligence, data". Empty = all acts.
- `maxResults` (integer): OJ mode only: the most acts to return, newest first, e.g. 50 (default). One charge per act returned.

### Output fields

- `schema_version` (string): Output schema version.
- `query` (string | null): The query as given (null in OJ mode).
- `celex` (string): CELEX number of the act, e.g. 32016R0679.
- `eli` (string | null): European Legislation Identifier URI of the act, e.g. http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj.
- `title` (string | null): Official title in the chosen language (null if Cellar has none in that language).
- `act_type` (string | null): Type of act, e.g. Regulation, Directive, Implementing regulation, Corrigendum.
- `act_type_code` (string | null): Publications Office resource-type code, e.g. REG, DIR, DEC_IMPL, CORRIGENDUM.
- `date_document` (string | null): Date of the document (signature/adoption), YYYY-MM-DD.
- `date_publication` (string | null): Date of publication in the Official Journal, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `oj_reference` (string | null): Official Journal reference for acts published act by act (since Oct 2023), e.g. "OJ L, 2024/1689".
- `date_entry_into_force` (string | null): Earliest date of entry into force, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `entry_into_force_dates` (array): All entry-into-force / effect dates EUR-Lex records (staged application), sorted.
- `date_end_of_validity` (string | null): End of validity, YYYY-MM-DD; null when open-ended.
- `in_force` (boolean | null): Whether EUR-Lex marks the act as in force today.
- `eur_lex_url` (string): EUR-Lex page of the original act.
- `summary_url` (string | null): EUR-Lex plain-language summary of the act, when one exists.
- `language` (string): Language of the text and titles returned (EN when the requested one was unavailable).
- `as_of` (string | null): The asOf date used (null = today).
- `latest_consolidated_version_date` (string | null): Date of the newest consolidated version EUR-Lex holds (may be later than asOf).
- `text_version` (string | null): "consolidated" (EUR-Lex consolidated version, documentation only) or "original" (OJ text); null if no text.
- `text_celex` (string | null): CELEX of the text the article was read from, e.g. 02024R1689-20260727 for a consolidated version.
- `consolidated_version_date` (string | null): Date of the consolidated version used, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `text_notice` (string | null): For consolidated texts: EUR-Lex's own disclaimer (no legal effect; the OJ text is authentic).
- `source_url` (string): EUR-Lex page of the exact text version used (consolidated version or OJ act).
- `cellar_url` (string | null): The Cellar document the text was read from.
- `amended_by` (array): Acts that amend this act: {celex, title, date, url}, newest first (include amendments).
- `corrected_by` (array): Corrigenda to this act: {celex, title, date, url}.
- `repealed_by` (array): Acts that repeal this act: {celex, title, date, url}.
- `implicitly_repealed_by` (array): Acts that implicitly repeal this act.
- `amends` (array): Acts this act amends: {celex, title, date, url}.
- `repeals` (array): Acts this act repeals.
- `implicitly_repeals` (array): Acts this act implicitly repeals.
- `citing_acts` (array | null): Legislation and case-law citing this act, newest first, up to maxCiting: {celex, title, date, url} (include citing).
- `citing_acts_total` (integer | null): How many legislative acts and judgments cite this act.
- `article` (string | null): The article returned, e.g. "50"; null for an act-level row.
- `paragraph` (string | null): The paragraph returned, e.g. "1"; null = whole article.
- `article_title` (string | null): Heading of the article, e.g. "Principles relating to processing of personal data".
- `article_text` (string | null): Plain text of the article (or paragraph), one line per paragraph or point, numbering kept ("1.", "(a)").
- `article_text_truncated` (boolean | null): True when article_text was cut at maxTextChars.
- `article_amended_by` (array): In a consolidated text: acts that changed this article (from EUR-Lex's change markers), {celex, change}.
- `recitals_count` (integer | null): Act-level row: number of recitals in the OJ text.
- `articles_count` (integer | null): Act-level row: number of articles in the text used.
- `table_of_contents` (array): Act-level row: [{article, title}] for every article, to pick one for a follow-up call.
- `text` (string | null): Whole act as plain text, cut at maxTextChars (include text only).
- `text_truncated` (boolean | null): True when text was cut at maxTextChars.
- `warnings` (array): Caveats in plain words: fallbacks, not in force on asOf, truncation, partial data.
- `retrieved_at` (string): When the row was made (ISO 8601, UTC).
- `duration_seconds` (number): How long the lookup took.

### Example input

```json
{ "query": "AI Act", "article": "50", "language": "EN", "asOf": "2026-11-05" }
```

## UK & Dutch Law Lookup API: article text by date, in force

Docs: https://boscolabs.dev/national-law-lookup.html
Apify Store: coming soon
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/national-law-lookup
Price: $0.01 per article or act returned
API: POST https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/national-law-lookup, $0.005 per article or act returned (max 10 articles)

The text of a UK section or Dutch article as in force today (or on a date), whether it is in force and what changed it. Ask by citation: "Companies Act 2006 s 172", "BW 7:658", "artikel 13 Wet Vpb 1969". Official legislation.gov.uk and Dutch BWB data with a source link per row.

Example questions:

- What does article 13 of the Dutch Wet op de vennootschapsbelasting 1969 say as of 1 January 2025? Quote it and link the source.

### Input fields

- `query` (string, required): The act, optionally with the article. UK: a short title with a section ("Companies Act 2006 s 172", "section 172 of the Companies Act 2006"), a short name ("CA 2006", "DPA 2018", "UK GDPR", "PECR"; 35 common acts), a legislation.gov.uk path or URL ("ukpga/2006/46/section/172"), a chapter ("2006 c. 46") or an SI ("S.I. 2003/2426 reg 6"). NL: "BW 7:658", "artikel 13 Wet Vpb 1969", "Awb 8:1", "art. 310 Sr", an abbreviation (BW1-10, Sr, Sv, Rv, Awb, UAVG, Wft, Wwft, Woo ...), a citeertitel, a BWB id ("BWBR0002672"), a jci reference or a wetten.overheid.nl URL. Required. An unreadable citation fails in seconds, with examples, at no charge.
- `jurisdiction` (string): "UK" or "NL". Default empty = detected from the citation (paths, BWB ids, known names, Dutch or English words); set it when a bare name is ambiguous.
- `article` (string): Section, regulation or article number, optionally with a subsection or lid: "172", "172(1)", "7:658", "13 lid 2", "8:1"; several separated by commas (up to 5, e.g. "171, 172"). One row per article. Overrides an article in the query. Empty = the article in the query, or else one row for the whole act with its table of contents.
- `asOf` (string): YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2025-01-01": return the text as in force on that date (UK point-in-time version; NL consolidated version, newest correction). Empty = today.
- `language` (string): Optional, "EN" or "NL". UK texts are English and Dutch texts are Dutch: there is no official English translation of Dutch legislation, so EN for a Dutch act returns the Dutch text with a warning. Default empty = the source language.
- `maxTextChars` (integer): Cap on article_text, in characters, e.g. 30000 (default). Longer text is cut and flagged (article_text_truncated) with a warning.

### Output fields

- `schema_version` (string): Output schema version.
- `query` (string | null): The query as given.
- `jurisdiction` (string): "UK" or "NL".
- `act_id` (string): Identifier of the act: legislation.gov.uk path ("ukpga/2006/46") or BWB id ("BWBR0005290"). Same role as celex in eu-law-lookup.
- `eli` (string | null): European Legislation Identifier URI (UK, e.g. http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2006/46); null for NL.
- `title` (string | null): Short title or citeertitel, e.g. "Companies Act 2006", "Burgerlijk Wetboek Boek 7".
- `long_title` (string | null): Long title (UK) or intitule (NL).
- `act_type` (string | null): Type of act, e.g. "UK Public General Act", "UK Statutory Instrument", "Wet", "Algemene maatregel van bestuur".
- `act_type_code` (string | null): Source code for the type: legislation.gov.uk type (ukpga, uksi, asp...) or BWB soort (wet, AMvB, ministeriele-regeling...).
- `date_document` (string | null): UK: date of Royal Assent or making; NL: date of signature. YYYY-MM-DD.
- `date_publication` (string | null): NL: issue date of the original Staatsblad/Staatscourant; null when unknown and for UK.
- `official_publication` (string | null): Official reference: UK chapter or SI number ("2006 c. 46", "S.I. 2003/2426"), NL publication ("Stb. 1991, 600"). Same role as oj_reference in eu-law-lookup.
- `date_entry_into_force` (string | null): UK article rows: when the section came into force (from its commencement note); NL: when the regulation first entered into force. YYYY-MM-DD.
- `date_end_of_validity` (string | null): NL: last day of the last consolidated version when the regulation has lapsed (vervallen); null when open-ended and for UK.
- `in_force` (boolean | null): Whether the returned article (for NL act rows: the act) is in force on as_of (default today). UK act rows: null.
- `act_url` (string): Official page of the act (legislation.gov.uk id URI or wetten.overheid.nl).
- `language` (string): Language of the text: EN (UK) or NL (NL).
- `as_of` (string | null): The asOf date used (null = today).
- `latest_consolidated_version_date` (string | null): Date of the newest consolidated (revised) version the source holds; may be later than as_of.
- `text_version` (string | null): "consolidated" (revised / geconsolideerde tekst) or "original" (as enacted or made, UK only).
- `consolidated_version_date` (string | null): Date from which the version used applies, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `text_notice` (string | null): Licence attribution and the source's status note: revised texts are editorial consolidations; for NL the authentic text is the Staatsblad/Staatscourant publication.
- `source_url` (string): Page of the exact text version used (article-level when available).
- `data_url` (string | null): The XML the text was read from. Same role as cellar_url in eu-law-lookup.
- `article` (string | null): The section, regulation or article returned, e.g. "172", "658", "8:1"; null for an act-level row.
- `paragraph` (string | null): The subsection (UK) or lid (NL) returned; null = whole article.
- `article_title` (string | null): Heading of the section or article (UK sections have one; most Dutch articles do not).
- `article_text` (string | null): Plain text, one line per subsection, paragraph or list item, numbering kept (UK "(1)", "(a)"; NL "1.", "a.").
- `article_text_truncated` (boolean | null): True when article_text was cut at maxTextChars.
- `article_amended_by` (array): Changes to this article: UK textual amendments shown with it (F-notes), NL the publication that last changed it. Items {source, date, change, url}.
- `pending_changes` (array): UK: changes legislation.gov.uk lists as not yet applied to this provision, {type, affected, source, url, in_force_date}. Always [] for NL.
- `articles_count` (integer | null): Act-level row: number of sections or articles (NL: not repealed).
- `table_of_contents` (array): Act-level row: [{article, title}] for up to 500 sections or articles, to pick one for a follow-up call.
- `warnings` (array): Caveats in plain words: not in force on asOf, repealed, newer version coming, fallbacks, truncation.
- `retrieved_at` (string): When the row was made (ISO 8601, UTC).
- `duration_seconds` (number): How long the lookup took.

### Example input

```json
{ "query": "Wet op de vennootschapsbelasting 1969 artikel 13", "asOf": "2025-01-01" }
```

## Dutch Case Law API (Rechtspraak): ECLI lookup, uitspraken

Docs: https://boscolabs.dev/dutch-case-law.html
Apify Store: coming soon
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/dutch-case-law
Price: $0.005 per decision returned

Dutch court decisions (uitspraken) by ECLI or search: court, dates, case numbers, legal area, summary (inhoudsindicatie), appeal/cassation relations, law references and optional text. Hoge Raad, Raad van State, gerechtshoven, rechtbanken. Official Rechtspraak Open Data, source link per row.

Example questions:

- Find Hoge Raad rulings on tenancy law (huurrecht) since 2024 and summarise what each one decided, with links.

### Input fields

- `ecli` (string): One or more Dutch ECLIs, separated by commas or spaces, e.g. "ECLI:NL:HR:2024:123" or "ECLI:NL:HR:2024:123, ECLI:NL:RVS:2024:1000" (max 100). Lower case and uitspraken.rechtspraak.nl links also work. One row per ECLI; an unknown ECLI fails at no charge. Empty = search with the fields below (both can be combined: ECLI rows come first).
- `query` (string): Words to find in the decision's title and summary (inhoudsindicatie), case-insensitive. Commas separate alternatives, words within one alternative must all appear: "huur, pacht" = huur OR pacht; "ontslag op staande voet" = all four words. Summaries are in Dutch, so use Dutch words. The official API has no full-text search: this filters the newest-updated decisions that match the other filters (up to 10,000 scanned). Empty = no keyword filter.
- `courts` (array): Court codes as used in the ECLI, e.g. ["HR"] for the Hoge Raad (Supreme Court); others: PHR (Procureur-Generaal/AG opinions), RVS (Raad van State), CRVB, CBB, GHAMS, GHARL, GHDHA, GHSHE (courts of appeal), RBAMS, RBDHA, RBROT, RBMNE ... (district courts). Full Dutch names also work. Empty = all courts.
- `legalAreas` (array): Rechtsgebied names, e.g. ["Strafrecht"], ["Belastingrecht", "Arbeidsrecht"]; English also works: criminal, civil, administrative, tax, employment, immigration, insolvency, family, competition, environmental. A main area includes its sub-areas. Empty = all areas.
- `dateFrom` (string): Earliest decision date (uitspraakdatum), YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2024-01-01". Empty = no lower limit (to today if dateTo is empty).
- `dateTo` (string): Latest decision date, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2024-12-31". Empty = today when dateFrom is set, else no limit.
- `documentType` (string): "uitspraak" = court decisions only, "conclusie" = opinions of the Advocate-General at the Hoge Raad only. Empty = both.
- `maxResults` (integer): Most decisions to return from a search, most recently published or updated first, e.g. 20 (default). One charge per decision returned.
- `includeText` (boolean): true = add the full decision as plain text (section headings as '## ', numbered paragraphs kept), cut at maxTextChars. Default false: metadata and summary only (small rows). Same price.
- `maxTextChars` (integer): With includeText: cap on the text per decision in characters, e.g. 20000 (default). Longer text is cut and flagged (text_truncated, text_chars gives the full length).

### Output fields

- `schema_version` (string): Output schema version.
- `ecli` (string): European Case Law Identifier of the decision, e.g. ECLI:NL:HR:2024:123.
- `title` (string | null): Rechtspraak's display title: ECLI, court, decision date and case numbers.
- `court` (string | null): Court (instantie) name, e.g. Hoge Raad, Raad van State, Rechtbank Amsterdam.
- `court_code` (string | null): Court code from the ECLI, e.g. HR, RVS, CRVB, GHAMS, RBAMS.
- `court_id` (string | null): The court's identifier URI in the Rechtspraak value list.
- `document_type` (string | null): "uitspraak" (decision) or "conclusie" (Advocate-General's opinion).
- `decision_date` (string | null): Date of the decision or opinion (uitspraakdatum), YYYY-MM-DD.
- `publication_date` (string | null): Date the text was published on rechtspraak.nl, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `modified` (string | null): Last change to the metadata or text, ISO 8601 (Rechtspraak local time).
- `case_numbers` (array): Case numbers (zaaknummers) as published, e.g. ["22/01066"].
- `seat` (string | null): Place of session (zittingsplaats), when given.
- `legal_areas` (array): Legal areas (rechtsgebieden), e.g. ["Strafrecht"].
- `procedures` (array): Procedure types, e.g. ["Cassatie"], ["Hoger beroep"].
- `language` (string | null): Language code of the metadata record (nl); English translations say so in the summary.
- `summary` (string | null): The court's own summary (inhoudsindicatie) as plain text; null when none.
- `relations` (array): Formal relations to other decisions: {ecli, relation (hogerBeroep, cassatie, conclusie, ...), direction (earlier = the other decision is from an earlier instance, later = a later one), outcome (e.g. bekrachtiging/bevestiging, vernietiging, contrair), label, url}.
- `references` (array): References to legislation and case law: {type (law, case_law, eu_law, local_regulation), label, identifier (BWB jci or ECLI), bwb_id, article, url}.
- `published_in` (array): Where the decision is published (vindplaatsen), e.g. ["Rechtspraak.nl", "NJ 2014/336"].
- `replaces` (array): Old identifiers (LJN) this ECLI replaces.
- `replaced_by` (string | null): ECLI that replaces this one, if it was withdrawn.
- `has_text` (boolean): Whether rechtspraak.nl publishes the decision text (false = metadata only).
- `text_chars` (integer | null): Length of the full plain text in characters (null without text).
- `text` (string | null): The decision as plain text (includeText only): '## ' section headings, numbering kept, footnotes at the end; cut at maxTextChars.
- `text_truncated` (boolean | null): True when text was cut at maxTextChars; null without includeText.
- `source_url` (string): The decision on uitspraken.rechtspraak.nl.
- `data_url` (string): The official Open Data XML this row was read from.
- `warnings` (array): Caveats in plain words: text cut, metadata only, replaced ECLI, keyword scan limit.
- `retrieved_at` (string): When the row was made (ISO 8601, UTC).
- `duration_seconds` (number): How long fetching this decision took.

### Example input

```json
{ "query": "huurrecht", "courts": ["HR"], "dateFrom": "2024-01-01", "maxResults": 20 }
```

## EU Public Tenders & Contract Awards API (TED procurement)

Docs: https://boscolabs.dev/eu-tenders.html
Apify Store: coming soon
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/eu-tenders
Price: $0.002 per notice

EU public procurement notices from TED, the EU's official tenders journal (EU, EEA and more, since 2016): open calls with deadlines, contract awards with winners and values, prior information. Filter by keyword, buyer country, CPV code, notice type, date and EUR value. Use for tender alerts.

Coverage: Every country that publishes on TED: the 27 EU member states, Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Switzerland, candidate countries and EU-funded procurement abroad; about 22,000 notices a week. History from November 2016 (complete from 2017). New notices are available the day they are published.

Example questions:

- Find open IT tenders above 1 million euros in Germany and the Netherlands from the last two weeks and list their deadlines.
- Which companies won construction contracts from Polish buyers last month, and for how much?
- Alert me to new cloud hosting tenders in the Nordics every morning.

### Input fields

- `keywords` (string): Full-text search over the whole notice, in any language; a notice matches when it contains all words, e.g. "cloud hosting". Empty = no keyword filter.
- `countries` (array): Buyer countries as ISO 3166 alpha-2 (DE, FR, NL, PL, ...) or alpha-3 (DEU) codes, e.g. ["DE", "NL"]. Alpha-3 works for any country, e.g. UKR. Empty = all countries.
- `cpvCodes` (array): Common Procurement Vocabulary (CPV) code prefixes as digit strings; a prefix matches every code below it, e.g. ["72"] = IT services, "45" = construction work, "3312" = medical equipment, "72212000" = one specific code. Empty = all sectors.
- `noticeTypes` (array): Kinds of notices: contract_notice (open call for tenders), contract_award (who won, for how much), prior_information, direct_award_preannouncement, contract_modification, market_consultation. Default ["contract_notice"]. Pass [] for all kinds.
- `publishedFrom` (string): Earliest publication date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-10-01". The TED API covers notices from November 2016. Empty = 7 days before `publishedTo`.
- `publishedTo` (string): Latest publication date, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty = today.
- `minValueEur` (integer): Minimum total notice value in EUR, e.g. 1000000 (estimated value for calls, awarded value for awards). When set, notices stated in other currencies (e.g. PLN, SEK) and notices without a value are left out, as TED does not convert currencies. Empty = no minimum.
- `maxResults` (integer): Maximum notices, newest first, e.g. 100. Default 50. You pay per notice delivered.
- `onlyNewSinceLastRun` (boolean): true = skip (and don't charge for) notices an earlier run with the same filters already delivered. For scheduled runs. Default false. Remembered in a named key-value store in your account.

### Output fields

- `schema_version` (string): Output schema version.
- `notice_id` (string): TED publication number, e.g. 760925-2026. Unique per notice.
- `notice_type` (string | null): contract_notice, contract_award, prior_information, direct_award_preannouncement, contract_modification or market_consultation (from TED's form type).
- `ted_notice_type` (string | null): TED's detailed notice type code, e.g. cn-standard, can-standard, pin-only, can-modif.
- `published` (string | null): Publication date in the Official Journal S (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `deadline` (string | null): Deadline for receipt of tenders (earliest over all lots), ISO date or date-time with UTC offset. Null when the notice has none (e.g. award notices).
- `title` (string | null): Notice title, English when TED provides it (TED's 'Country – CPV – title' form), else the original language.
- `title_language` (string | null): ISO 639 language code of title, e.g. eng.
- `description` (string | null): Short description of the procurement (max. 500 characters), English if available, else the original language. E-mail addresses and phone numbers are removed. Null for legacy (pre-eForms) notices.
- `description_language` (string | null): ISO 639 language code of description, e.g. deu.
- `buyer_name` (string | null): Name of the (first) buyer: the contracting authority or entity.
- `buyer_country` (string | null): Country of the buyer, ISO 3166 alpha-3 (e.g. DEU), as published by TED.
- `buyer_city` (string | null): City of the buyer.
- `cpv_codes` (array): All CPV codes of the notice (8 digits, no check digit), duplicates removed.
- `main_cpv` (string | null): Main CPV code of the procedure (eForms notices only).
- `estimated_value` (number | null): Estimated value of the procedure, excl. VAT, in currency. Not converted.
- `awarded_value` (number | null): Total value of the contracts awarded in this notice, excl. VAT, in currency (award notices).
- `currency` (string | null): ISO 4217 currency of awarded_value, or of estimated_value when there is no awarded value.
- `winner_names` (array | null): Names of the winning tenderers (award notices; usually companies).
- `procedure_type` (string | null): Procedure type as coded by TED, e.g. open, restricted. Null when not given.
- `lots_count` (integer | null): Number of lots (eForms notices only).
- `ted_url` (string): Notice page on ted.europa.eu.
- `source_url` (string): Official XML of the notice on ted.europa.eu.
- `retrieved_at` (string): UTC time the notice was fetched from the TED API.

### Example input

```json
{
  "keywords": "software",
  "countries": ["DE", "NL", "FR"],
  "cpvCodes": ["72", "48"],
  "noticeTypes": ["contract_notice", "contract_award"],
  "publishedFrom": "2026-10-01",
  "minValueEur": 100000,
  "maxResults": 200
}
```

## Pentagon / DoD Contract Awards API: winners, amounts, tickers

Docs: https://boscolabs.dev/dod-contract-awards.html
Apify Store: coming soon
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/dod-contract-awards
Price: $0.005 per award row

Pentagon/DoD contract awards of $7.5M+ the same evening they are announced, plus USAspending.gov history since FY2008 (any federal agency). Winner, amount, service, NAICS/PSC, matched to a US stock ticker with SEC shares outstanding. Filter by date, agency, amount, company, ticker.

Coverage: Same evening: the Pentagon's daily contract list (weekdays, rows in by about 7 p.m. New York). History: the USAspending.gov API from 2007-10-01, for the Department of Defense or any other federal agency. DoD contract actions reach USAspending up to 90 days after signing, so the default window is the last 135 days.

Example questions:

- Which Kratos contracts did the Pentagon award in 2019, and how large were they?
- Who won the largest Navy shipbuilding contracts (NAICS 336611) in 2025?
- Show Department of Homeland Security contracts over $10 million signed in the first half of 2026.

### Input fields

- `source` (string): "both" (default) = the Pentagon's same-evening contract list (published around 5 p.m. New York on the signing day, face values, DoD only) plus the USAspending history (obligations, ~3 months behind for DoD). "dailyList" = only the same-evening list rows. "history" = only USAspending. The list has no NAICS/PSC codes, so it is skipped when naicsCodes or pscCodes are set, and when agencies excludes the Department of Defense.
- `dateFrom` (string): Earliest action (signing) date, or announcement date for same-evening list rows, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2019-01-01". History from 2007-10-01 (FY2008). Empty = 135 days before `dateTo`, because DoD data is published up to 90 days late (about 105 days observed).
- `dateTo` (string): Latest action (signing) date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2019-12-31". Empty = today. The last ~3 months of DoD data are incomplete.
- `agencies` (array): Top-tier awarding agency names as USAspending spells them, e.g. ["Department of Defense"], ["Department of Homeland Security"], ["National Aeronautics and Space Administration"]. Default ["Department of Defense"]. Pass [] for ALL federal agencies.
- `minAmountUsd` (integer): Minimum summed obligations per award and day, in USD, e.g. 1000000. Default 7500000, the DoD's public announcement threshold (the daily 5 p.m. contracts list). 0 = every award-day except net de-obligations (negative sums).
- `recipients` (array): Winning company search terms, matched by USAspending against recipient and parent names, e.g. ["kratos", "huntington ingalls"]. Empty = all recipients.
- `tickers` (array): Only awards matched to these US-listed tickers (NYSE, Nasdaq, CBOE), e.g. ["LMT", "KTOS", "AVAV"]. Turns ticker matching on. Empty = no ticker filter.
- `naicsCodes` (array): NAICS industry codes, 2 to 6 digits, e.g. ["336414"] (guided missiles and space vehicles) or ["3364"]. Empty = all.
- `pscCodes` (array): Product and Service Codes, e.g. ["1410"] (guided missiles), ["R425"] (engineering support). Empty = all.
- `matchTickers` (boolean): true (default) = match the recipient or its parent company to a US-listed ticker by exact cleaned name (SEC company list) and add the SEC-reported shares outstanding. Unmatched awards are still returned, with ticker = null.
- `maxResults` (integer): Maximum award rows, newest signing dates first, then largest amounts, e.g. 20. Default 100. Each row is one charged event.
- `onlyNewSinceLastRun` (boolean): true = skip (and don't charge for) award-days (including old-dated actions the DoD publishes late) an earlier run with the same filters already delivered. For scheduled runs. Default false. Remembered in a named key-value store in your account.

### Output fields

- `schema_version` (string): Output schema version.
- `source` (string): Where the row comes from: "usaspending" (obligation records, ~3 months late for DoD) or "dod_daily_list" (the Pentagon's same-evening contract list, parsed by AI with checks). The two are separate records of an award and are never summed or deduped.
- `award_id` (string | null): Contract PIID (USAspending 'Award ID'); for daily-list rows the contract number in the text, null when none is stated.
- `parent_award_id` (string | null): PIID of the parent IDV (IDIQ, BPA, GSA schedule) for task and delivery orders; null for standalone contracts.
- `award_key` (string): USAspending generated_internal_id: unique award key (PIID + agency + parent IDV).
- `action_date` (string): Signing (action) date, YYYY-MM-DD; for daily-list rows the announcement date.
- `amount_usd` (number): USAspending rows: obligated amount in USD, that day's actions on this award summed (modifications can be negative). Daily-list rows: the amount as stated (see amount_basis); for a multiple-award contract the full shared ceiling on every awardee's row (see shared_award).
- `is_ceiling` (boolean): True when amount_usd is a ceiling, not money committed (amount_basis is "ceiling"): an IDIQ maximum or a multiple-award ceiling. Kept for compatibility; use amount_basis and shared_award. Only daily-list rows can be true.
- `contract_number` (string | null): Contract number (PIID) as stated: for USAspending rows the same as award_id; for daily-list rows the number in the announcement paragraph, null when that paragraph states none.
- `award_kind` (string | null): What kind of award the row is. Daily list: from the announcement wording ("has been awarded a ... contract" = new_contract, "modification (P00012) to previously awarded contract" = modification, "exercises an option" = option_exercise, "task order", "delivery order" or an order under an ordering agreement, "multiple award" or "will compete for each order" = multiple_award_idiq, "single award" = single_award_idiq; an IDIQ that says neither is new_contract), kept only when such a keyword is in the paragraph. USAspending: award type A BPA CALL = bpa_call, B PURCHASE ORDER = new_contract, C DELIVERY ORDER = delivery_order (FPDS files task orders as delivery orders), D DEFINITIVE CONTRACT = new_contract; a day without the base award is option_exercise (action type G) or modification. Null when unknown.
- `pricing_type` (string | null): Contract pricing from the announcement wording ("firm-fixed-price", "cost-plus-fixed-fee", ...; hybrid = two or more named). Daily-list rows only; null for USAspending rows (the transaction search does not return it) and when the text names none.
- `amount_basis` (string | null): What amount_usd measures: ceiling (a maximum or multiple-award ceiling, not money committed; shared when shared_award is true), face_value (a definitive contract's or order's value), modification_value (the value of a modification), obligated (money obligated: every USAspending row), estimated. Null when the text does not say.
- `obligated_at_award_usd` (number | null): Daily list: the amount the announcement says is obligated at the time of award (0 for "no funds are obligated"), only when that figure is in a sentence about obligation; else null. USAspending: the obligated amount (same as amount_usd).
- `shared_award` (boolean | null): True when several companies share this one amount (a multiple-award contract: every awardee gets a row with the full ceiling). Never sum amount_usd over such rows: count each award_group_id once. False for USAspending rows; null for daily-list days read before schema 2.
- `awardees_count` (integer | null): Number of companies sharing this award_group_id (1 = not shared).
- `award_group_id` (string | null): Stable id shared by all rows of one award: daily list = one announcement paragraph and amount; USAspending = one award and signing day. To total money without double counting, take amount_usd once per award_group_id.
- `co_awardees` (array | null): The other companies in the same award_group_id (at most 20); empty when not shared.
- `completion_date` (string | null): Estimated completion date stated in the announcement, YYYY-MM-DD (a month alone: its last day); null when not stated and for USAspending rows.
- `classification_evidence` (string | null): The words that support award_kind, pricing_type and amount_basis, e.g. "multiple award; firm-fixed-price; maximum" (daily list) or "award type DELIVERY ORDER" (USAspending).
- `action_count` (integer): Number of contract actions summed into this row.
- `modification_numbers` (array): Modification numbers of those actions ('0' = the base award).
- `new_award` (boolean): True when the day includes the base award (modification 0), false for modifications only.
- `award_type` (string | null): DEFINITIVE CONTRACT, DELIVERY ORDER, PURCHASE ORDER or BPA CALL.
- `awarding_agency` (string | null): Top-tier awarding agency, e.g. Department of Defense.
- `awarding_sub_agency` (string | null): Awarding sub-agency, e.g. Department of the Navy, Department of the Army, Department of the Air Force, Defense Logistics Agency, Missile Defense Agency.
- `recipient_name` (string | null): Contractor (recipient) name as reported.
- `recipient_uei` (string | null): Recipient Unique Entity ID (SAM.gov).
- `parent_name` (string | null): Parent company name from the USAspending award record.
- `parent_uei` (string | null): Parent company UEI.
- `recipient_city` (string | null): Recipient city.
- `recipient_state` (string | null): Recipient state code (daily-list rows: the state as written, e.g. Virginia).
- `recipient_country` (string | null): Recipient country.
- `performance_state` (string | null): Place of performance state code.
- `performance_country` (string | null): Place of performance country.
- `naics_code` (string | null): NAICS industry code.
- `naics_description` (string | null): NAICS description.
- `psc_code` (string | null): Product and Service Code.
- `psc_description` (string | null): PSC description.
- `description` (string | null): Description of the day's largest action (max 300 characters).
- `ticker` (string | null): US-listed ticker (NYSE, Nasdaq, CBOE) of the recipient or its parent, by exact cleaned-name match; null when not matched.
- `matched_on` (string | null): Which name matched the ticker: the recipient itself or its parent company.
- `sec_cik` (integer | null): SEC Central Index Key of the matched company.
- `sec_company_name` (string | null): Company name in SEC's ticker list.
- `exchange` (string | null): Exchange of the ticker in SEC's list.
- `shares_outstanding` (integer | null): Shares outstanding from the SEC cover page (dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding), the count of the action date (latest on or before it, else the earliest). Multiply by your own price for a market cap.
- `shares_as_of` (string | null): Date of that share count, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `usaspending_url` (string): Award page on USAspending.gov.
- `source_url` (string | null): USAspending API record of the award; for daily-list rows the war.gov article, null when the e-mail did not link it.
- `data_lag_note` (string): Reporting lag of the source: DoD actions appear up to 90 days after signing.
- `retrieved_at` (string): UTC time the row was built.

### Example input

```json
{
  "dateFrom": "2019-01-01",
  "dateTo": "2019-12-31",
  "tickers": ["KTOS"],
  "maxResults": 1000
}
```

## US Federal Awards API: contracts & grants, all agencies

Docs: https://boscolabs.dev/us-federal-awards.html
Apify Store: coming soon
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/us-federal-awards
Price: $0.004 per award row

US federal contract, grant and loan awards from every agency (USAspending.gov): winner, UEI, parent company, stock ticker, agency, amounts, dates, NAICS/PSC/assistance listing, place of performance and a source link. Filter by company, ticker, agency, keyword, state, date.

Example questions:

- Which federal contracts did Palantir win this quarter?
- Largest NASA contracts last month
- Grants to universities in Texas for AI this year

### Input fields

- `recipients` (array): Winning organisations, as name text or 12-character SAM UEI, e.g. ["palantir"], ["university of texas"] or ["FSY4LVSBGWB7"]. USAspending matches the text against recipient and parent company names and UEIs. Empty (default) = all recipients.
- `tickers` (array): Only awards whose recipient or its parent company matches these US-listed tickers (NYSE, Nasdaq, CBOE; exact cleaned SEC company name), e.g. ["PLTR"] or ["LMT", "BAH"]. Subsidiaries are found through their parent company. Empty (default) = no ticker filter; every row still gets a ticker when its name matches.
- `agencies` (array): Awarding agencies by abbreviation, name or toptier code, e.g. ["NASA"], ["Department of Energy"], ["097"] (DoD). A name that is not a top-tier agency is searched as a sub-agency, e.g. ["Defense Logistics Agency"]. Empty (default) = all federal agencies.
- `awardTypes` (array): Which awards: "contracts" (USAspending codes A-D: BPA calls, purchase orders, delivery orders, definitive contracts), "grants" (02-05: block, formula, project grants, cooperative agreements), "loans" (07, 08), "direct_payments" (06, 10), "other" (09, 11: insurance, other assistance). E.g. ["grants"]. Default ["contracts"].
- `keywords` (array): Full-text search over award descriptions and other text fields, e.g. ["artificial intelligence"] or ["cybersecurity"]. Several keywords = any of them. Empty (default) = no keyword filter.
- `naicsCodes` (array): NAICS industry codes, 2 to 6 digits, e.g. ["541512"] (computer systems design) or ["3364"]. Contracts only. Empty (default) = all.
- `pscCodes` (array): Product and Service Codes, e.g. ["DA01"] (IT software development) or ["AR"] (space R&D). Contracts only. Empty (default) = all.
- `cfdaNumbers` (array): Assistance listing (CFDA) numbers as NN.NNN, e.g. ["47.070"] (NSF computer and information science) or ["93.855"] (NIH allergy and infectious diseases). Financial assistance only. Empty (default) = all.
- `placeOfPerformanceStates` (array): Two-letter US state or territory codes where the work is done, e.g. ["TX"] or ["VA", "MD", "DC"]. Empty (default) = anywhere, including abroad.
- `dateFrom` (string): Earliest action date (signing date of the award or of a modification), YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-07-01". Searchable from 2007-10-01. Empty (default) = 30 days before dateTo. DoD contracts appear up to 90 days late.
- `dateTo` (string): Latest action date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-09-30". Empty (default) = today.
- `minAmount` (integer): Only awards whose total obligated amount (all actions since signing) is at least this many US dollars, e.g. 1000000. Empty or 0 (default) = no minimum.
- `sortBy` (string): "amount" (default) = awards ordered by their largest action (obligation) in the date window, largest first; that action is the one shown. "date" = ordered by their latest action in the window, newest first. Loans-only searches rank by loan face value.
- `maxResults` (integer): Maximum award rows, one per award, e.g. 20. Default 20, maximum 1000. Each row is one charged event.

### Output fields

- `schema_version` (string): Output schema version.
- `award_id` (string | null): Award identifier as USAspending shows it: contract PIID, or FAIN/URI for financial assistance.
- `award_key` (string): USAspending generated_internal_id: the unique award key, also used in source_url.
- `award_type_group` (string | null): contracts, grants, loans, direct_payments or other (from the USAspending award type code).
- `award_type` (string | null): Award type as USAspending describes it, e.g. DEFINITIVE CONTRACT, DELIVERY ORDER, PROJECT GRANT (B), COOPERATIVE AGREEMENT (B).
- `award_type_code` (string | null): USAspending award type code, e.g. D (definitive contract), C (delivery order), 04 (project grant), 05 (cooperative agreement), 07 (direct loan).
- `parent_award_id` (string | null): PIID of the parent IDV (IDIQ, BPA, GSA schedule) for task and delivery orders; null otherwise.
- `recipient_name` (string | null): Recipient (winner) name as published by USAspending.
- `recipient_uei` (string | null): Recipient's SAM.gov Unique Entity ID (12 characters).
- `parent_name` (string | null): Parent company of the recipient, from the USAspending award record.
- `parent_uei` (string | null): Parent company's UEI.
- `recipient_city` (string | null): Recipient's city.
- `recipient_state` (string | null): Recipient's US state code.
- `recipient_country` (string | null): Recipient's country.
- `ticker` (string | null): US stock ticker (NYSE/Nasdaq/CBOE) when the recipient or parent name exactly matches an SEC-listed company after cleaning; null otherwise. Derived by Bosco Labs, not by USAspending.
- `matched_on` (string | null): "recipient" or "parent": which name matched the ticker; null when no ticker.
- `awarding_agency` (string | null): Top-tier awarding agency, e.g. National Aeronautics and Space Administration.
- `awarding_sub_agency` (string | null): Awarding sub-agency, e.g. Department of the Navy, National Institutes of Health.
- `funding_agency` (string | null): Top-tier funding agency (can differ from the awarding agency).
- `action_date` (string | null): Date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the award's action shown in this row: its largest action in the date window (sortBy amount) or its latest (sortBy date).
- `action_amount_usd` (number | null): Federal obligation of that action in USD (negative = de-obligation; 0 for administrative modifications and loans).
- `modification_number` (string | null): Modification number of that action ("0" or empty = the base award).
- `total_obligated_usd` (number | null): Total obligated on the award so far, all actions since signing, in USD.
- `total_value_usd` (number | null): Contracts: potential total value including all options (base_and_all_options), USD. Loans: loan face value. Null for other assistance.
- `award_date_signed` (string | null): Date the award was first signed (base award), YYYY-MM-DD. Earlier than dateFrom = the row is a modification of an older award.
- `start_date` (string | null): Period of performance start, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `end_date` (string | null): Period of performance current end, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `description` (string | null): Award description, cut at 300 characters.
- `naics_code` (string | null): NAICS industry code (contracts).
- `naics_description` (string | null): NAICS industry title.
- `psc_code` (string | null): Product and Service Code (contracts).
- `psc_description` (string | null): Product and Service Code title.
- `cfda_number` (string | null): Assistance listing (CFDA) number (financial assistance), e.g. 47.070.
- `cfda_title` (string | null): Assistance listing title.
- `performance_city` (string | null): Place of performance city.
- `performance_state` (string | null): Place of performance US state code.
- `performance_country` (string | null): Place of performance country.
- `source_url` (string): The award's page on usaspending.gov (the source to cite).
- `api_url` (string): The award record in the USAspending API (JSON).
- `retrieved_at` (string): When this row was retrieved, ISO-8601 UTC.

### Example input

```json
{
  "agencies": ["NASA"],
  "awardTypes": ["contracts"],
  "dateFrom": "2026-10-01",
  "dateTo": "2026-10-31",
  "maxResults": 20
}
```

## ECB Rates & Euro Inflation API: policy rates, FX, €STR, HICP

Docs: https://boscolabs.dev/eu-rates-inflation.html
Apify Store: coming soon
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/eu-rates-inflation
Price: $0.002 per series returned
API: POST https://api.boscolabs.dev/v1/eu-rates-inflation, $0.002 per series returned (catalogue free) (max 20 series)

Latest value, previous value, change and recent history of ECB policy rates, euro reference FX rates, €STR, euro-area and national bond yields, and Eurostat HICP inflation. Ask by plain name (ecb_deposit_rate, eur_fx:USD, hicp:NL), no SDMX keys. Official data, a source link per series.

Example questions:

- What's the ECB deposit rate now, when did it last change, and how does euro-area inflation compare? Cite the source.

### Input fields

- `series` (array): Which series to fetch, by plain name (case-insensitive), up to 20 per run, e.g. ["ecb_deposit_rate", "eur_fx:USD", "hicp:EA"]. Names: ecb_deposit_rate, ecb_main_refi_rate, ecb_marginal_lending_rate (one observation per rate change), estr (€STR), eur_fx:<CUR> (ECB reference rate, CUR per 1 EUR, e.g. eur_fx:GBP), euro_area_yield_curve:<maturity> (AAA spot yield, e.g. 10Y, 3M, 1Y6M; add :all for all government bonds), gov_bond_10y:<country> (monthly 10-year yield, e.g. gov_bond_10y:IT), hicp:<geo>[:<variant>] (Eurostat inflation; geo EA, EU or NL, DE, ...; variant annual (default), monthly, index, core, energy, food, services, goods, or an ECOICOP 2 code like CP01). An unknown name fails at once with suggestions and costs nothing. Empty (with no rawSeriesKey) = list the catalogue for free.
- `last` (integer): How many of the newest observations to return per series, e.g. 12 (the last 12 months of a monthly series). Empty = 12, or with dateFrom every observation in the window (up to 1000). latest_value, previous_value and change are always filled. The price is the same for any number.
- `dateFrom` (string): First date of the window, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-01-01". For monthly series the month holding the date counts. Empty = no lower bound (only `last` limits).
- `dateTo` (string): Last date of the window, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-03-15". With last = 1 you get the value on that date or the last one before it (weekends and holidays have no FX value). Empty = up to the latest published value.
- `frequency` (string): Only where the source has it: eur_fx daily (default), monthly or annual averages; policy rates daily (rate on every day) instead of the default one-row-per-change. Other series keep their own frequency and say so in `warnings`. Empty = each series' default.
- `rawSeriesKey` (array): Optional full ECB Data Portal series keys (dataflow + key, every dimension filled, no wildcards), e.g. ["EXR.M.CHF.EUR.SP00.E"]. Same output and price as named series. Empty = none.
- `mode` (string): "series" (default) fetches the series above. "catalogue" returns one row per supported name pattern with its source dataset, key template, frequencies, unit and an example, free of charge.

### Output fields

- `schema_version` (string): Output schema version, "1".
- `series` (string): The series as requested, normalised (e.g. eur_fx:USD, hicp:NL:core), or the raw ECB key.
- `title` (string | null): The series title exactly as the source states it (ECB TITLE; Eurostat dataset, category, area and unit labels). null on error rows.
- `description` (string): What the series is and how to read it, in plain words (written by Bosco Labs).
- `source` (string): Publisher of the values.
- `dataset` (string): Source dataset: ECB dataflow (FM, EST, EXR, YC, IRS, ...) or Eurostat dataset code (prc_hicp_minr).
- `series_key` (string): Exact series identifier at the source: ECB dataflow.key (e.g. EXR.D.USD.EUR.SP00.A) or Eurostat dataset/freq.unit.coicop18.geo.
- `frequency` (string | null): changes (one observation per policy-rate change), daily, monthly, quarterly or annual.
- `unit` (string | null): Unit of the values, e.g. percent per annum, USD per 1 EUR, annual rate of change, %.
- `latest_date` (string | null): Date of the newest observation: YYYY-MM-DD (daily, change dates), YYYY-MM (monthly), YYYY (annual). For policy rates: the day the current rate took effect.
- `latest_value` (number | null): Newest value, unmodified from the source.
- `previous_date` (string | null): Date of the observation before the newest one (for policy rates: the previous change).
- `previous_value` (number | null): Value of that previous observation, unmodified.
- `change` (number | null): latest_value - previous_value, computed by Bosco Labs (exact decimal difference); not an official ECB or Eurostat figure.
- `observations` (array): The newest `last` observations, oldest first, each {date, value, status}. status is the source's observation flag, null when normal (ECB: P provisional, E estimated; Eurostat: e estimated, p provisional, b break in series).
- `observation_count` (integer): Number of entries in observations.
- `source_url` (string | null): Human-readable page of the series: ECB Data Portal series page or Eurostat data browser table.
- `api_url` (string | null): The exact API request the values came from (re-run it to verify).
- `attribution` (string): Required source credit: names the source, says the values are unmodified and available free of charge from it, and marks `change` as computed by Bosco Labs. Keep it when you republish the values.
- `warnings` (array): Caveats in plain words, e.g. a requested frequency the series doesn't have, or a window cut to the newest 1000 observations.
- `error` (string | null): Why this series has no data (unknown currency, area or category, empty date window, source down), with valid examples. Rows with an error are not charged.
- `retrieved_at` (string): When the data was fetched (ISO 8601, UTC).
- `duration_seconds` (number): How long fetching all series took.

### Example input

```json
{ "series": ["ecb_deposit_rate", "eur_fx:USD", "hicp:EA"] }
```

## ClinicalTrials.gov API: trial search & NCT dossier

Docs: https://boscolabs.dev/clinical-trials.html
Apify Store: coming soon
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=bosco_labs/clinical-trials
Price: $0.004 per trial

Clinical trials as compact JSON rows: status, phase, sponsor, conditions, interventions, enrollment, start and primary completion dates, countries, outcomes and results. Look up NCT numbers or search by condition, drug, sponsor, phase, status, country and dates. Sourced, no contact data.

Example questions:

- What is the status and primary completion date of NCT05813925? Cite the ClinicalTrials.gov record.

### Input fields

- `nctIds` (array): ClinicalTrials.gov identifiers to look up, NCT + 8 digits, e.g. ["NCT05813925"]. Up to 100, in one API call; one row per trial found, in the order given. When set, all search filters below are ignored. Empty = search mode.
- `condition` (string): Condition or disease to search for, e.g. "obesity" or "non-small cell lung cancer". Matches ClinicalTrials.gov's condition field including its synonyms; supports OR/AND, e.g. "obesity OR overweight". Empty = any condition.
- `intervention` (string): Drug, biologic, device or procedure name, e.g. "semaglutide" or "semaglutide OR tirzepatide". Use molecule or brand names; a drug class like "GLP-1" only matches trials that write it. Empty = any intervention.
- `sponsor` (string): Lead sponsor organisation, e.g. "Novo Nordisk" (matches "Novo Nordisk A/S"). Searches the lead sponsor only, not collaborators. Empty = any sponsor.
- `phase` (array): Trial phases to include, any of EARLY_PHASE1, PHASE1, PHASE2, PHASE3, PHASE4, NA, e.g. ["PHASE3"]. A phase 2/3 trial matches both PHASE2 and PHASE3. Empty = all phases (observational studies have none).
- `status` (array): Overall recruitment status of the trial, e.g. ["RECRUITING", "NOT_YET_RECRUITING"]. UNKNOWN = status not verified for over 2 years. Empty = any status.
- `locationCountries` (array): Trials with at least one site in any of these countries, e.g. ["Germany", "DK"] or ["Europe"]. Accepts country names as ClinicalTrials.gov writes them ("United States", "South Korea", "Czechia"), common ISO alpha-2 codes, and the regions "Europe" (45 European countries incl. UK, Switzerland, Norway, Ukraine) and "EU" (27 member states). Empty = anywhere.
- `startDateFrom` (string): Earliest trial start date (actual or planned), YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY, e.g. "2025-01-01". Inclusive. Empty = no lower bound.
- `startDateTo` (string): Latest trial start date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2025-12-31". Inclusive. Empty = no upper bound (includes planned future starts).
- `primaryCompletionFrom` (string): Earliest primary completion date (actual or estimated: when the primary endpoint data are complete, the usual read-out catalyst), YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-01-01". Empty = no lower bound.
- `primaryCompletionTo` (string): Latest primary completion date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-12-31". Empty = no upper bound.
- `hasResults` (boolean): true = only trials with results posted on ClinicalTrials.gov; false = only trials without. Leave empty (omit) for both.
- `maxResults` (integer): Maximum number of trials (rows) to return in search mode, e.g. 20. Default 20, maximum 500. Each row is one charged `trial` event, so this also caps the cost. Ranked by relevance when a condition or intervention is given, else newest start date first.
- `detail` (string): "summary" (default): the compact dossier. "full" also fills eligibility (criteria up to 4,000 characters, sex, ages), arms (up to 20), secondary outcomes (up to 15) and sites (facility, city, country, status; up to 100). Same price.

### Output fields

- `nct_id` (string | null): ClinicalTrials.gov identifier, e.g. NCT05813925.
- `title` (string | null): Brief title.
- `acronym` (string | null): Study acronym, e.g. REDEFINE 5.
- `status` (string | null): Overall recruitment status, e.g. RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, UNKNOWN.
- `phases` (array | null): Phases, e.g. ["PHASE3"] or ["PHASE2", "PHASE3"] for a phase 2/3 trial; empty for observational studies.
- `study_type` (string | null): INTERVENTIONAL, OBSERVATIONAL or EXPANDED_ACCESS.
- `conditions` (array | null): Conditions or diseases studied, as registered.
- `interventions` (array | null): Interventions: type (DRUG, BIOLOGICAL, DEVICE, PROCEDURE, BEHAVIORAL, ...) and name.
- `sponsor` (string | null): Lead sponsor organisation; null when the record lists a private individual as sponsor (class INDIV).
- `sponsor_class` (string | null): Lead sponsor class: INDUSTRY, NIH, FED, OTHER_GOV, NETWORK, OTHER (e.g. universities), ...
- `collaborators` (array | null): Collaborating organisations (individuals, class INDIV, left out).
- `enrollment_count` (integer | null): Number of participants (actual or planned, see enrollment_type).
- `enrollment_type` (string | null): ACTUAL or ESTIMATED.
- `start_date` (string | null): Study start date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM when only the month is registered).
- `start_date_type` (string | null): ACTUAL or ESTIMATED; null when not stated.
- `primary_completion_date` (string | null): Primary completion date (last participant's primary endpoint data collected), ISO 8601, may be YYYY-MM.
- `primary_completion_date_type` (string | null): ACTUAL or ESTIMATED.
- `completion_date` (string | null): Study completion date, ISO 8601, may be YYYY-MM.
- `completion_date_type` (string | null): ACTUAL or ESTIMATED.
- `last_update_posted` (string | null): Date the record was last updated on ClinicalTrials.gov (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `countries` (array | null): Countries with at least one listed site, sorted.
- `site_count` (integer | null): Number of sites (locations) listed in the record.
- `primary_outcomes` (array | null): Primary outcome measures (up to 5; see primary_outcomes_total).
- `primary_outcomes_total` (integer | null): Number of primary outcomes registered.
- `has_results` (boolean | null): true if results are posted on ClinicalTrials.gov.
- `results_first_posted` (string | null): Date results were first posted (YYYY-MM-DD), null if none.
